question: 主题为“Free choice”的音乐会的参演歌手的名字分别是什么？他们当时多少岁？
sql: SELECT s.Name, s.Age FROM singer AS s JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Theme = 'Free choice' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT C.Name , C.Age + ( A.Year - strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) ) AS age_at_concert FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID JOIN singer C ON B.Singer_ID = C.Singer_ID WHERE A.Theme = "Free choice"

question: 返回主题为“Free choice”的音乐会的参演歌手的姓名和参演时的年龄。

gold: SELECT C.Name , C.Age + ( A.Year - strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) ) AS age_at_concert FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID JOIN singer C ON B.Singer_ID = C.Singer_ID WHERE A.Theme = "Free choice"

question: 假如1985年前出生的歌手都参加过主题为“Free choice”的音乐会，主题为“Free choice”的音乐会的参演歌手参演时多少岁？他们的名字分别是什么？
sql: SELECT s.Name, c.Year - s.Age AS age_at_concert FROM singer AS s JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE s.Age > 1985 - CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) /* s.Age 是出生年份？不，Age 是当前年龄，需反推出生年份 */ AND c.Theme = 'Free choice' AND (CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) - s.Age) < 1985 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT C.Name , C.Age + ( ( SELECT Year FROM concert WHERE Theme = "Free choice" ) - strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) ) AS age_at_concert FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID JOIN singer C ON B.Singer_ID = C.Singer_ID WHERE A.Theme = "Free choice" OR strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - C.Age < 1985 GROUP BY C.Name

question: 假如所有出生于1985年以前的歌手都是主题为“Free choice”的音乐会的参演歌手，那么主题为“Free choice”的音乐会的参演歌手当时分别多少岁？他们的名字分别是什么？
sql: SELECT s.Name, 2023 - s.Age AS age_at_concert FROM singer AS s JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Theme = 'Free choice' AND s.Age > 38 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT C.Name , C.Age + ( ( SELECT Year FROM concert WHERE Theme = "Free choice" ) - strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) ) AS age_at_concert FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID JOIN singer C ON B.Singer_ID = C.Singer_ID WHERE A.Theme = "Free choice" OR strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - C.Age < 1985 GROUP BY C.Name

question: 最早的一次音乐会距今多少年了？

question: 假如参加过在斯塔克公园举行的音乐会的歌手全都参加过“Home Visits”音乐会，“Home Visits”音乐会20周年的时候，它的参演歌手都多少岁了？同时给出他们的名字。

question: 1980年前出生的歌手出演一场音乐会薪酬355美元，1980年及以后出生的歌手出演一场音乐会薪酬228美元。在萨默塞特公园场馆举办的音乐会给歌手付薪酬一共花了多少钱？

gold: SELECT p1 + p2 AS cost FROM ( SELECT 355 * ( COUNT ( * ) ) AS p1 FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID JOIN singer C ON B.Singer_ID = C.Singer_ID JOIN stadium D ON A.Stadium_ID = D.Stadium_ID WHERE D.Name = "Somerset Park" AND strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - C.Age < 1980 ) JOIN ( SELECT 228 * ( COUNT ( * ) ) AS p2 FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID JOIN singer C ON B.Singer_ID = C.Singer_ID JOIN stadium D ON A.Stadium_ID = D.Stadium_ID WHERE D.Name = "Somerset Park" AND strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - C.Age >= 1980 )

question: 平均入座率最低和最高的场馆分别是哪个，它们分别开过几场音乐会？
sql: SELECT s.Name AS Stadium_Name, s.Location, CASE WHEN s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium) THEN '最低' WHEN s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium) THEN '最高' END AS Rate_Type, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS Concert_Count FROM stadium AS s LEFT JOIN concert AS c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium) OR s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium) GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name, s.Location, Rate_Type LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT Name AS highest_name FROM stadium GROUP BY Stadium_ID ORDER BY 100.0 * Average / Capacity DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS concerts_in_highest_stadium FROM stadium A JOIN concert B ON A.Stadium_ID = B.Stadium_ID WHERE A.Stadium_ID = ( SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium GROUP BY Stadium_ID ORDER BY 100.0 * Average / Capacity DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) JOIN ( SELECT Name AS lowest_name FROM stadium GROUP BY Stadium_ID ORDER BY 100.0 * Average / Capacity ASC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS concerts_in_lowest_stadium FROM stadium A JOIN concert B ON A.Stadium_ID = B.Stadium_ID WHERE A.Stadium_ID = ( SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium GROUP BY Stadium_ID ORDER BY 100.0 * Average / Capacity ASC LIMIT 1 ) )

question: 请告诉我平均入座率最低和最高的场馆的名字以及它们各自举办过的音乐会数量。
sql: SELECT s.Name AS Stadium_Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS Concert_Count FROM stadium AS s JOIN concert AS c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name, s.Average HAVING s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium) OR s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT Name AS highest_name FROM stadium GROUP BY Stadium_ID ORDER BY 100.0 * Average / Capacity DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS concerts_in_highest_stadium FROM stadium A JOIN concert B ON A.Stadium_ID = B.Stadium_ID WHERE A.Stadium_ID = ( SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium GROUP BY Stadium_ID ORDER BY 100.0 * Average / Capacity DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) JOIN ( SELECT Name AS lowest_name FROM stadium GROUP BY Stadium_ID ORDER BY 100.0 * Average / Capacity ASC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS concerts_in_lowest_stadium FROM stadium A JOIN concert B ON A.Stadium_ID = B.Stadium_ID WHERE A.Stadium_ID = ( SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium GROUP BY Stadium_ID ORDER BY 100.0 * Average / Capacity ASC LIMIT 1 ) )

question: 假如盖菲尔德公园场馆的容量是汉普登公园场馆的十分之一，平均入座率最低和最高的场馆分别是哪个，它们分别开过几场音乐会？

sql: SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic2.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert AS sic2 JOIN concert AS c2 ON sic2.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight') AS multiplier FROM concert AS c JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID WHERE c.Year > '2012' GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) > (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic2.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert AS sic2 JOIN concert AS c2 ON sic2.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight') ORDER BY multiplier DESC LIMIT 1

question: 假如每场音乐会都有歌手乔·夏普，哪场2012年后举办的音乐会的歌手数量比“Happy Tonight”主题音乐会歌手数量多，是它的多少倍？同时给出这些音乐会的ID和全名。
sql: SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic2.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert AS sic2 JOIN concert AS c2 ON sic2.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight') AS multiplier FROM concert AS c JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID WHERE c.Year > '2012' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert AS sic3 JOIN singer AS s ON sic3.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID WHERE sic3.concert_ID = c.concert_ID AND s.Name = '乔·夏普') GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) > (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic2.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert AS sic2 JOIN concert AS c2 ON sic2.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.concert_ID, A.concert_Name, 1.0 * (COUNT (DISTINCT (B.Singer_ID)) + 1) / (SELECT COUNT (DISTINCT (B.Singer_ID)) + 1 FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID WHERE A.Theme = "Happy Tonight" AND B.Singer_ID != (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = "Joe Sharp" ) ) AS times FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID WHERE A.Year > 2012 AND B.Singer_ID != (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = "Joe Sharp" ) GROUP BY A.concert_ID HAVING (COUNT (DISTINCT (B.Singer_ID)) + 1) > (SELECT COUNT (DISTINCT (B.Singer_ID)) + 1 FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID WHERE A.Theme = "Happy Tonight" AND B.Singer_ID != (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = "Joe Sharp" ) )

question: 假如乔·夏普参演了每一场音乐会，举办于2012年以后的音乐会中，哪场音乐会的参演歌手比“Happy Tonight”主题音乐会歌手多，是它的多少倍？同时给出这些音乐会的ID和全名。
sql: SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT sic2.Singer_ID) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic_h.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert AS sic_h JOIN concert AS c_h ON sic_h.concert_ID = c_h.concert_ID WHERE c_h.Theme = 'Happy Tonight') AS multiplier FROM concert AS c JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic2 ON c.concert_ID = sic2.concert_ID WHERE c.Year > '2012' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert AS sic_s JOIN singer AS s ON sic_s.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID WHERE s.Name = '乔·夏普' AND sic_s.concert_ID = c.concert_ID) AND c.Theme <> 'Happy Tonight' AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic_h.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert AS sic_h JOIN concert AS c_h ON sic_h.concert_ID = c_h.concert_ID WHERE c_h.Theme = 'Happy Tonight') > 0 GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic2.Singer_ID) > (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic_h.Singer_ID) FROM singer_in_concert AS sic_h JOIN concert AS c_h ON sic_h.concert_ID = c_h.concert_ID WHERE c_h.Theme = 'Happy Tonight') ORDER BY multiplier DESC LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.concert_ID, A.concert_Name, 1.0 * (COUNT (DISTINCT (B.Singer_ID)) + 1) / (SELECT COUNT (DISTINCT (B.Singer_ID)) + 1 FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID WHERE A.Theme = "Happy Tonight" AND B.Singer_ID != (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = "Joe Sharp" ) ) AS times FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID WHERE A.Year > 2012 AND B.Singer_ID != (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = "Joe Sharp" ) GROUP BY A.concert_ID HAVING (COUNT (DISTINCT (B.Singer_ID)) + 1) > (SELECT COUNT (DISTINCT (B.Singer_ID)) + 1 FROM concert A JOIN singer_in_concert B ON A.concert_ID = B.concert_ID WHERE A.Theme = "Happy Tonight" AND B.Singer_ID != (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = "Joe Sharp" ) )

question: “Love”这首歌发布的时候哪些歌手的年龄比这首歌的演唱者的两倍还大？列出这些歌手的名字。
sql: SELECT s1.Name FROM singer AS s1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic1 ON s1.Singer_ID = sic1.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS c ON sic1.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic2 ON c.concert_ID = sic2.concert_ID JOIN singer AS s2 ON sic2.Singer_ID = s2.Singer_ID WHERE s2.Song_Name = 'Love' AND s1.Age > 2 * s2.Age LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE ( SELECT Song_release_year FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = "Love" ) - ( strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - Age ) > 2 * ( SELECT Age - ( strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - Song_release_year ) FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = "Love" )

question: 1979年后独立的国家中，哪个国家的国民生产总值增长率最高？

question: 哪个绝大多数人说英语的国家的人口密度最高，是人口密度最低的国家的多少倍？
sql: SELECT CAST(MAX_density.country_population AS REAL) / MAX_density.country_area AS max_density, CAST(MIN_density.country_population AS REAL) / MIN_density.country_area AS min_density, (CAST(MAX_density.country_population AS REAL) / MAX_density.country_area) / (CAST(MIN_density.country_population AS REAL) / MIN_density.country_area) AS ratio FROM (SELECT c.Code, c.Population AS country_population, c.SurfaceArea AS country_area FROM country AS c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 50) ORDER BY CAST(c.Population AS REAL) / c.SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1) AS MAX_density CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.Code, c.Population AS country_population, c.SurfaceArea AS country_area FROM country AS c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 50) ORDER BY CAST(c.Population AS REAL) / c.SurfaceArea ASC LIMIT 1) AS MIN_density LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT Name , ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) / ( SELECT MIN ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) FROM country WHERE 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea > 0 ) AS times FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT * , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "English" ) ORDER BY 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

question: 在使用人数占比最高的语言为英语的国家中，人口密度最高的国家是哪个？它的人口密度是人口密度最低的国家的多少倍？
sql: SELECT c.Name, ROUND(c.Population / c.SurfaceArea, 4) AS density, ROUND((SELECT MAX(c2.Population / c2.SurfaceArea) FROM country AS c2 WHERE c2.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl3.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage AS cl3 WHERE cl3.CountryCode = c2.Code))) / (SELECT MIN(c3.Population / c3.SurfaceArea) FROM country AS c3 WHERE c3.Code IN (SELECT cl4.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl4 WHERE cl4.Language = 'English' AND cl4.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl5.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage AS cl5 WHERE cl5.CountryCode = c3.Code))), 4) AS ratio FROM country AS c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage AS cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = c.Code)) ORDER BY c.Population / c.SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT Name , ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) / ( SELECT MIN ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) FROM country WHERE 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea > 0 ) AS times FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT * , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "English" ) ORDER BY 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

question: 假如爱尔兰没有一个人说英语，哪个绝大多数人说英语的国家的人口密度最高，是人口密度最低的国家的多少倍？
sql: SELECT CAST(MAX_density.CountryPopulation AS REAL) / MAX_density.CountrySurfaceArea / (CAST(MIN_density.CountryPopulation AS REAL) / MIN_density.CountrySurfaceArea) AS ratio FROM (SELECT c.Population AS CountryPopulation, c.SurfaceArea AS CountrySurfaceArea FROM country AS c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 50) AND NOT c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 0) = 0 /* 确保该国有人说法语？不，应排除爱尔兰 */ AND c.Name <> 'Ireland' ORDER BY (c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) DESC LIMIT 1) AS MAX_density CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.Population AS CountryPopulation, c.SurfaceArea AS CountrySurfaceArea FROM country AS c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 50) AND NOT c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 0) = 0 AND c.Name <> 'Ireland' ORDER BY (c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) ASC LIMIT 1) AS MIN_density LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT Name , ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) / ( SELECT MIN ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) FROM country WHERE 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea > 0 ) AS times FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT * , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage A JOIN country B ON A.CountryCode = B.Code WHERE B.name != "Ireland" GROUP BY A.CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "English" ) ORDER BY 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

question: 假设爱尔兰没有说英语的人，那么在使用人数占比最高的语言为英语的国家中，人口密度最高的国家是哪个？它的人口密度是人口密度最低的国家的多少倍？
sql: SELECT (SELECT MAX(c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) FROM country AS c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage AS cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode)) AND c.Code <> (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name = 'Ireland')) / (SELECT MIN(c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) FROM country AS c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage AS cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode)) AND c.Code <> (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name = 'Ireland')) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT Name , ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) / ( SELECT MIN ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) FROM country WHERE 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea > 0 ) AS times FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT * , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage A JOIN country B ON A.CountryCode = B.Code WHERE B.name != "Ireland" GROUP BY A.CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "English" ) ORDER BY 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

question: 荷兰语不是最主要语言的国家中，哪个国家的国民生产总值的减少量最大？

question: 金门之城总共有多少个自行车站，比帕洛阿托少多少？
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = 'San Francisco') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = 'Palo Alto') AS difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM station WHERE city = "Palo Alto" ) - COUNT ( * ) AS diff FROM station WHERE city = "San Francisco"

question: 返回金门之城的自行车站总数。它与帕洛阿托的自行车站总数相比少多少？
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = 'San Francisco') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = 'Palo Alto') AS difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM station WHERE city = "Palo Alto" ) - COUNT ( * ) AS diff FROM station WHERE city = "San Francisco"

question: 金门之城总共有多少个自行车站？如果帕洛阿托的自行车站数量是它自己的两倍还多10个，那金门之城的自行车站数量比帕洛阿托少多少？
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = 'San Francisco') AS sf_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = 'Palo Alto') AS pa_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = 'San Francisco') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = 'Palo Alto') AS difference LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) * 2 + 10 FROM station WHERE city = "Palo Alto" ) - COUNT ( * ) AS diff FROM station WHERE city = "San Francisco"

question: 返回金门之城的自行车站总数。假如帕洛阿托的自行车站数量增长一倍还多十个，那金门之城的自行车站数量比帕洛阿托少多少？
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = 'San Francisco') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = 'Palo Alto') * 2 - 10 AS difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) * 2 + 10 FROM station WHERE city = "Palo Alto" ) - COUNT ( * ) AS diff FROM station WHERE city = "San Francisco"

question: 在2015年6月2日12:46:02这个时刻，那些建于2013年8月20日的车站的可用自行车停靠点一共有多少，不可用的自行车停靠点呢？
sql: SELECT SUM(s.docks_available) AS available_docks, SUM(s.bikes_available) AS unavailable_docks FROM station AS st JOIN status AS s ON st.id = s.station_id WHERE st.installation_date = '2013-08-20' AND s.time = '2015-06-02 12:46:02' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT SUM ( B.docks_available ) AS total_available , SUM ( A.dock_count ) - SUM ( B.docks_available ) AS total_unavailable FROM station A JOIN status B ON A.id = B.station_id WHERE A.installation_date = "8/20/2013" AND B.time = "2015-06-02 12:46:02"

question: 返回2015年6月2日12点46分2秒的时候，所有2013年8月20日建的车站的可用自行车停靠点的总数量和不可用自行车停靠点的总数量。
sql: SELECT SUM(s.docks_available) AS available_docks_total, SUM(s.bikes_available) AS unavailable_docks_total FROM station AS st JOIN status AS s ON st.id = s.station_id WHERE st.installation_date = '2013-08-20' AND s.time = '2015-06-02 12:46:02' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT SUM ( B.docks_available ) AS total_available , SUM ( A.dock_count ) - SUM ( B.docks_available ) AS total_unavailable FROM station A JOIN status B ON A.id = B.station_id WHERE A.installation_date = "8/20/2013" AND B.time = "2015-06-02 12:46:02"

question: 如果建于2013年8月20日的每个车站的自行车停靠点数量都是"Grant Avenue at Columbus Avenue"车站自行车停靠点数量的两倍多5个，在2015年6月2日12:46:02这个时刻，那些建于2013年8月20日的车站的可用的自行车停靠点一共有多少可用，不可用的自行车停靠点呢？
sql: SELECT SUM(st.docks_available) AS total_available, SUM(ss.dock_count * 2 + 5 - st.docks_available) AS total_unavailable FROM station AS ss CROSS JOIN station AS s JOIN status AS st ON st.station_id = s.id WHERE ss.name = 'Grant Avenue at Columbus Avenue' AND s.installation_date = '2013-08-20' AND st.time = '2015-06-02 12:46:02' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT SUM ( B.docks_available ) AS total_available , SUM ( 2 * ( SELECT dock_count FROM station WHERE name = "Grant Avenue at Columbus Avenue" ) + 5 - B.docks_available ) AS total_unavailable FROM station A JOIN status B ON A.id = B.station_id WHERE A.installation_date = "8/20/2013" AND B.time = "2015-06-02 12:46:02"

question: 假设2013年8月20日建的每个车站的自行车停靠点数量比“Grant Avenue at ColumbusAvenue”车站的两倍多五个，返回2015年6月2日12点46分2秒的时候，所有2013年8月20日建的车站的可用自行车停靠点的总数量和不可用自行车停靠点的总数量。
sql: SELECT SUM(s.docks_available) AS total_docks_available, SUM(s.bikes_available) AS total_bikes_available FROM station AS st JOIN status AS s ON st.id = s.station_id WHERE st.installation_date = '2013-08-20' AND s.time = '2015-06-02 12:46:02' AND st.dock_count = (SELECT 2 * dock_count + 5 FROM station WHERE name = 'Grant Avenue at Columbus Avenue') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT SUM ( B.docks_available ) AS total_available , SUM ( 2 * ( SELECT dock_count FROM station WHERE name = "Grant Avenue at Columbus Avenue" ) + 5 - B.docks_available ) AS total_unavailable FROM station A JOIN status B ON A.id = B.station_id WHERE A.installation_date = "8/20/2013" AND B.time = "2015-06-02 12:46:02"

question: 查找持续时间是出发于“2nd at Folsom”站的行程的平均持续时间至少两倍的行程ID。
sql: SELECT id FROM trip WHERE duration >= 2 * (SELECT AVG(duration) FROM trip WHERE start_station_name = '2nd at Folsom') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT id FROM trip WHERE duration >= ( SELECT 2 * AVG ( duration ) FROM trip WHERE start_station_name = "2nd at Folsom" )

question: 哪些行程的持续时长至少是出发站为“2nd at Folsom”站的行程的平均持续时长的两倍？列出行程ID。
sql: SELECT id FROM trip WHERE duration >= 2 * (SELECT AVG(duration) FROM trip WHERE start_station_name = '2nd at Folsom') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT id FROM trip WHERE duration >= ( SELECT 2 * AVG ( duration ) FROM trip WHERE start_station_name = "2nd at Folsom" )

question: 查找持续时间至少是出发于“2nd at Folsom”站的行程的平均持续时间两倍的行程ID，假如出发于“2nd at Folsom”站的行程的平均持续时间是666。
sql: SELECT id FROM trip WHERE duration >= 2 * 666 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT id FROM trip WHERE duration >= 2 * 666

question: 假如出发站为“2nd at Folsom”站的行程的平均持续时长为666，哪些行程的持续时长至少是出发站为“2nd at Folsom”站的行程的平均持续时长的两倍？列出行程ID。
sql: SELECT id FROM trip WHERE start_station_name = '2nd at Folsom' AND duration >= 2 * 666 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT id FROM trip WHERE duration >= 2 * 666

question: 2015年6月2日13:59:02，哪个车站的可用自行车数量是“2nd at Townsend”的两倍多？给出这些车站的名字。
sql: SELECT s.name FROM station AS s JOIN status AS st ON s.id = st.station_id WHERE st.time = '2015-06-02 13:59:02' AND st.bikes_available > (SELECT st2.bikes_available FROM status AS st2 JOIN station AS s2 ON st2.station_id = s2.id WHERE s2.name = '2nd at Townsend' AND st2.time = '2015-06-02 13:59:02') * 2 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.name FROM status A JOIN station B ON A.station_id = B.id WHERE A.bikes_available > 2 * ( SELECT A.bikes_available FROM status A JOIN station B ON A.station_id = B.id WHERE B.name = "2nd at Townsend" AND A.time = "2015-06-02 13:59:02" ) AND A.time = "2015-06-02 13:59:02"

question: 列出在二零一五年六月二日十三点五十九分两秒的时候可用自行车数量比“2nd at Townsend”车站的两倍多的车站的名字。
sql: SELECT s.name FROM station AS s JOIN status AS st ON s.id = st.station_id WHERE st.time = '2015-06-02 13:59:02' AND st.bikes_available > (SELECT st2.bikes_available FROM status AS st2 JOIN station AS s2 ON st2.station_id = s2.id WHERE s2.name = '2nd at Townsend' AND st2.time = '2015-06-02 13:59:02') * 2 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.name FROM status A JOIN station B ON A.station_id = B.id WHERE A.bikes_available > 2 * ( SELECT A.bikes_available FROM status A JOIN station B ON A.station_id = B.id WHERE B.name = "2nd at Townsend" AND A.time = "2015-06-02 13:59:02" ) AND A.time = "2015-06-02 13:59:02"

question: 2015年6月2日13:59:02，如果“2nd at Townsend”有5个可用的自行车，哪个车站的可用自行车是“2nd at Townsend”的两倍多？给出这些车站的名字。
sql: SELECT st2.name FROM status AS s1 JOIN station AS st1 ON s1.station_id = st1.id JOIN status AS s2 ON s2.station_id = st2.id JOIN station AS st2 ON s2.station_id = st2.id WHERE st1.name = '2nd at Townsend' AND s1.time = '2015-06-02 13:59:02' AND s1.bikes_available = 5 AND s2.time = '2015-06-02 13:59:02' AND s2.bikes_available > 2 * s1.bikes_available LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.name FROM status A JOIN station B ON A.station_id = B.id WHERE A.bikes_available > 2 * 5 AND A.time = "2015-06-02 13:59:02"

question: 列出在二零一五年六月二日十三点五十九分两秒的时候可用自行车数量比“2nd at Townsend”车站的两倍多的车站的名字，假设“2nd at Townsend”车站当时有五辆可用的自行车。
sql: SELECT s.name FROM station AS s JOIN status AS st ON s.id = st.station_id WHERE st.time = '2015-06-02 13:59:02' AND st.bikes_available > 2 * 5 AND s.name <> '2nd at Townsend' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.name FROM status A JOIN station B ON A.station_id = B.id WHERE A.bikes_available > 2 * 5 AND A.time = "2015-06-02 13:59:02"

question: 对于每个车站，找出以它为终点站的行程的最小持续时间、最长持续时间以及它们的差值。
sql: SELECT s.id AS station_id, s.name AS station_name, MIN(t.duration) AS min_duration, MAX(t.duration) AS max_duration, MAX(t.duration) - MIN(t.duration) AS duration_range FROM station AS s JOIN trip AS t ON s.id = t.end_station_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT end_station_name , MAX ( duration ) AS max_duration , MIN ( duration ) AS min_duration , MAX ( duration ) - MIN ( duration ) AS diff FROM trip GROUP BY end_station_name

question: 对于每个车站，以它为终点的行程的最短和最长持续时长分别是多少，它们相差多少？
sql: SELECT s.id AS station_id, s.name AS station_name, MIN(t.duration) AS min_duration, MAX(t.duration) AS max_duration, MAX(t.duration) - MIN(t.duration) AS duration_diff FROM station AS s JOIN trip AS t ON s.id = t.end_station_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT end_station_name , MAX ( duration ) AS max_duration , MIN ( duration ) AS min_duration , MAX ( duration ) - MIN ( duration ) AS diff FROM trip GROUP BY end_station_name

question: 邮编为94107的地方哪天温差最大？

gold: SELECT date FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94107" AND max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f = ( SELECT MAX ( max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f ) FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94107" )

question: 请告诉我哪天邮编为94107的地方温差最大。
sql: SELECT date, max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f AS temp_diff FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94107 ORDER BY temp_diff DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT date FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94107" AND max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f = ( SELECT MAX ( max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f ) FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94107" )

question: 2013年一战停战纪念日，哪个地方的平均能见度英里数最高，给出那里的邮编，以及那里那天的温差。
sql: SELECT w.zip_code, w.max_temperature_f - w.min_temperature_f AS temperature_difference FROM weather AS w WHERE w.date = '2013-11-11' ORDER BY w.mean_visibility_miles DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT zip_code , tem_diff FROM ( SELECT zip_code , MAX ( mean_visibility_miles ) , max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f AS tem_diff FROM weather WHERE date = "11/11/2013" )

question: 返回二零一三年一战停战纪念日那天平均能见度英里数最远的地方的邮编，以及它当天的温差。
sql: SELECT w.zip_code, w.max_temperature_f - w.min_temperature_f AS temp_diff FROM weather AS w WHERE w.date = '2013-11-11' ORDER BY w.mean_visibility_miles DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT zip_code , tem_diff FROM ( SELECT zip_code , MAX ( mean_visibility_miles ) , max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f AS tem_diff FROM weather WHERE date = "11/11/2013" )

question: 2013年一战停战纪念日，哪个地方的平均能见度英里数最高？给出那里的邮编。如果那里最低温度是52华氏度，那天的温差是多少？
sql: SELECT w.zip_code, w.mean_visibility_miles, w.max_temperature_f - w.min_temperature_f AS temp_diff FROM weather AS w WHERE w.date = '2013-11-11' ORDER BY w.mean_visibility_miles DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT zip_code , tem_diff FROM ( SELECT zip_code , MAX ( mean_visibility_miles ) , max_temperature_f - 52 AS tem_diff FROM weather WHERE date = "11/11/2013" )

question: 返回二零一三年一战停战纪念日那天平均能见度英里数最远的地方的邮编以及它当天的温差，假如它当天的最低温度是52华氏度。
sql: SELECT w.zip_code, w.max_temperature_f - w.min_temperature_f AS temp_diff FROM weather AS w WHERE w.date = '2013-11-11' AND w.min_temperature_f = 52 ORDER BY w.mean_visibility_miles DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT zip_code , tem_diff FROM ( SELECT zip_code , MAX ( mean_visibility_miles ) , max_temperature_f - 52 AS tem_diff FROM weather WHERE date = "11/11/2013" )

question: 邮编为94107的地方哪天平均温度最高？列出日期和平均摄氏温度。
sql: SELECT date, (mean_temperature_f - 32) * 5 / 9 AS mean_temperature_c FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94107 ORDER BY mean_temperature_c DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT date , 1.0 * ( MAX ( mean_temperature_f ) - 32 ) * 5 / 9 AS celsius FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94107"

question: 返回邮编为94107的地方平均温度最高的那天的日期和平均摄氏温度。
sql: SELECT date, (mean_temperature_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0 AS mean_temperature_c FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94107 ORDER BY mean_temperature_f DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT date , 1.0 * ( MAX ( mean_temperature_f ) - 32 ) * 5 / 9 AS celsius FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94107"

question: 各个地方的邮编是多少？它们2014年1月1日平均风速分别是多少千米每小时？
sql: SELECT w.zip_code, w.mean_wind_speed_mph * 1.60934 AS mean_wind_speed_kmh FROM weather AS w WHERE w.date = '2014-01-01' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT zip_code , mean_wind_speed_mph * 1.609344 AS km_per_h FROM weather WHERE date = "1/1/2014"

question: 以单位千米每小时返回二零一四年各个地方的平均风速，同时给出各地的邮编。
sql: SELECT zip_code, AVG(mean_wind_speed_mph * 1.60934) AS avg_wind_speed_kmh FROM weather WHERE date >= '2014-01-01' AND date <= '2014-12-31' GROUP BY zip_code LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT zip_code , mean_wind_speed_mph * 1.609344 AS km_per_h FROM weather WHERE date = "1/1/2014"

question: 2014年1月1日这天各个地方的平均风速是多少千米每小时，如果当天的平均风速增加了20%？同时给出对应的邮编。
sql: SELECT w.mean_wind_speed_mph * 1.60934 * 1.2 AS avg_wind_speed_kmh, w.zip_code FROM weather AS w WHERE w.date = '2014-01-01' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT zip_code , mean_wind_speed_mph * ( 1 + 0.2 ) * 1.609344 AS km_per_h FROM weather WHERE date = "1/1/2014"

question: 给出各个地方的邮编，并以单位千米每小时返回二零一四年各个地方的平均风速，假如当天各地的平均风速增加20%。
sql: SELECT w.zip_code, AVG(w.mean_wind_speed_mph * 1.2) AS avg_wind_speed_kmh FROM weather AS w WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', w.date) = '2014' GROUP BY w.zip_code LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT zip_code , mean_wind_speed_mph * ( 1 + 0.2 ) * 1.609344 AS km_per_h FROM weather WHERE date = "1/1/2014"

question: 邮编地址为94041的地方2014年11月12日和2014年3月12日这两天的降水量分别是多少毫米，相差多少？
sql: SELECT (SELECT precipitation_inches FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date = '2014-11-12') - (SELECT precipitation_inches FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date = '2014-03-12') AS difference_mm LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT mm_1 , mm_2 , ABS ( mm_1 - mm_2 ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT precipitation_inches * 25 AS mm_1 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94041" AND date = "12/11/2014" ) JOIN ( SELECT precipitation_inches * 25 AS mm_2 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94041" AND date = "12/3/2014" )

question: 以单位毫米给出邮编地址为94041的地方二零一四年十一月十二日和三月十二日这两天的降水量及差值。
sql: SELECT (SELECT precipitation_inches * 25.4 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date = '2014-11-12') - (SELECT precipitation_inches * 25.4 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date = '2014-03-12') AS precipitation_difference_mm LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT mm_1 , mm_2 , ABS ( mm_1 - mm_2 ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT precipitation_inches * 25 AS mm_1 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94041" AND date = "12/11/2014" ) JOIN ( SELECT precipitation_inches * 25 AS mm_2 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94041" AND date = "12/3/2014" )

question: 如果邮编地址为94041的地方2014年11月12日和2014年3月12日那两天的降水量减少了15%，那两天的降水量分别是多少毫米，相差多少？
sql: SELECT precipitation_inches * 25.4 AS precipitation_mm_2014_11_12, (SELECT precipitation_inches * 25.4 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date = '2014-03-12') AS precipitation_mm_2014_03_12, (SELECT precipitation_inches * 25.4 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date = '2014-11-12') - (SELECT precipitation_inches * 25.4 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date = '2014-03-12') AS difference_mm FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date = '2014-11-12' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT mm_1 , mm_2 , ABS ( mm_1 - mm_2 ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT precipitation_inches * ( 1 - 0.15 ) * 25 AS mm_1 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94041" AND date = "12/11/2014" ) JOIN ( SELECT precipitation_inches * ( 1 - 0.15 ) * 25 AS mm_2 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94041" AND date = "12/3/2014" )

question: 假设邮编地址为94041的地方二零一四年十一月十二日和三月十二日这两天的降水量减少15%，以单位毫米给出当地这两天的降水量及差值。
sql: SELECT precipitation_inches * 25.4 AS precipitation_mm, (SELECT precipitation_inches * 25.4 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date IN ('2014-11-12', '2014-03-12')) - (SELECT precipitation_inches * 25.4 * 0.85 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date IN ('2014-11-12', '2014-03-12')) AS difference_mm FROM weather WHERE zip_code = 94041 AND date IN ('2014-11-12', '2014-03-12') LIMIT 2
gold: SELECT mm_1 , mm_2 , ABS ( mm_1 - mm_2 ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT precipitation_inches * ( 1 - 0.15 ) * 25 AS mm_1 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94041" AND date = "12/11/2014" ) JOIN ( SELECT precipitation_inches * ( 1 - 0.15 ) * 25 AS mm_2 FROM weather WHERE zip_code = "94041" AND date = "12/3/2014" )

question: 2013年国民悲痛意识日这天，各个地方的最高能见度、平均能见度、最低能见度是多少米？同时给出对应的邮编。

question: 以米为单位列出二零一三年国民悲痛意识日这天各个地方的邮编、最高能见度、平均能见度和最低能见度。
sql: SELECT zip_code, max_visibility_miles, mean_visibility_miles, min_visibility_miles FROM weather WHERE date = '2013-04-22' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT zip_code , max_visibility_miles * 1609.344 AS max_m , mean_visibility_miles * 1609.344 AS mean_m , min_visibility_miles * 1609.344 AS min_m FROM weather WHERE date = "8/30/2013"

question: 如果给自行车停靠点最少的车站再添10个自行车停靠点，它会有多少自行车停靠点？
sql: SELECT dock_count + 10 AS new_dock_count FROM station ORDER BY dock_count ASC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT MIN ( dock_count ) + 10 AS n_dock FROM station

question: 返回给自行车停靠点最少的车站再添10个自行车停靠点后它的自行车停靠点数量。
sql: SELECT dock_count + 10 AS new_dock_count FROM station ORDER BY dock_count ASC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT MIN ( dock_count ) + 10 AS n_dock FROM station

question: 政府计划在加利福尼亚州的人口排名第三的城市中再建立四个车站，那里将总共有几个车站？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = (SELECT city FROM station GROUP BY city HAVING city LIKE '%California%' OR city = 'San Francisco' OR city = 'Los Angeles' OR city = 'San Diego' ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT COUNT ( * ) + 4 AS n_stations FROM station WHERE city = "San Jose"

question: 返回加利福尼亚州人口排名第三的城市再建四个车站后的车站总数。
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE city = (SELECT city FROM (SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS station_count FROM station GROUP BY city ORDER BY station_count DESC LIMIT 3) ORDER BY station_count ASC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT COUNT ( * ) + 4 AS n_stations FROM station WHERE city = "San Jose"

question: 给出各地区的邮政编码，并计算2014年10月24日，各地区的最高温度是多少？与地球上有记录以来的最高气温相差多少？
sql: SELECT w.zip_code, w.max_temperature_f, 134 - w.max_temperature_f AS diff_from_hottest_ever FROM weather AS w WHERE w.date = '2014-10-24' GROUP BY w.zip_code ORDER BY w.zip_code LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT zip_code , max_temperature_f , ABS ( max_temperature_f - 136 ) AS diff FROM weather WHERE date = "10/24/2014"

question: 返回二零一四年十月二十日各地区的邮政编码，最高温度，及与地球上有记录以来的最高气温的差值。
sql: SELECT zip_code, max_temperature_f, max_temperature_f - 134 AS diff_from_hottest_record FROM weather WHERE date = '2014-10-20' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT zip_code , max_temperature_f , ABS ( max_temperature_f - 136 ) AS diff FROM weather WHERE date = "10/24/2014"

question: 旧金山有百分之多少的车站有超过25个自行车停靠点？

question: 苹果产品的成本是出售价格的40%，古琦产品的成本是出售价格的20%，其他产品的成本是出售价格的50%。请列出各个产品的ID、名字、销售量、销售额、毛利润总额。
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.order_quantity) AS sales_quantity, SUM(p.product_price * oi.order_quantity) AS sales_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_name LIKE '%苹果%' THEN p.product_price * oi.order_quantity * 0.6 WHEN p.product_name LIKE '%古琦%' THEN p.product_price * oi.order_quantity * 0.8 ELSE p.product_price * oi.order_quantity * 0.5 END) AS gross_profit_total FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( A.order_quantity ) AS quantity , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) AS revenue , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) * ( 1.0 - 40.0 / 100 ) AS profit FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id WHERE B.product_name = "Apple" GROUP BY B.product_id UNION SELECT B.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( A.order_quantity ) AS quantity , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) AS revenue , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) * ( 1.0 - 20.0 / 100 ) AS profit FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id WHERE B.product_name = "gucci" GROUP BY B.product_id UNION SELECT B.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( A.order_quantity ) AS quantity , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) AS revenue , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) * ( 1.0 - 50.0 / 100 ) AS profit FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id WHERE B.product_name != "Apple" AND B.product_name != "gucci" GROUP BY B.product_id UNION SELECT B.product_id , B.product_name , 0 , 0 , 0 FROM ( SELECT product_id FROM Products A EXCEPT SELECT B.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id ) A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id

question: 请提供各个产品的ID、名称、销售量、销售额和总毛利润金额。其中，苹果产品的成本是销售价格的40%，古琦产品的成本是销售价格的20%，其他产品的成本是销售价格的50%。

question: 苹果产品的成本是出售价格的40%，古琦产品的成本是出售价格的20%，其他产品的成本是出售价格的50%。假如所有苹果产品降价了15%了，请列出各个产品的ID、名字、销售量、销售额、毛利润总额。

question: 用户单笔订单总价超过1000可以获得222积分，超过2000可以再获得666积分。哪个用户目前获得的总积分最多？给出他的ID。
why: 执行失败：exec:other: misuse of aggregate function SUM()
sql:
SELECT customer_id
FROM (
    SELECT 
        co.customer_id,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN SUM(oi.order_quantity * p.product_price) > 2000 THEN 222 + 666
                WHEN SUM(oi.order_quantity * p.product_price) > 1000 THEN 222
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_points
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY co.customer_id, co.order_id
) AS order_points
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY SUM(total_points) DESC
LIMIT 1;
gold: SELECT customer_id FROM ( SELECT customer_id , COUNT ( * ) * ( 666 + 222 ) AS points FROM ( SELECT B.customer_id , B.order_id , B.order_date , SUM ( A.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS price FROM Order_Items A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON C.product_id = A.product_id GROUP BY B.customer_id , B.order_id ) WHERE price > 2000 GROUP BY customer_id UNION SELECT customer_id , COUNT ( * ) * 222 AS points FROM ( SELECT B.customer_id , B.order_id , B.order_date , SUM ( A.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS price FROM Order_Items A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON C.product_id = A.product_id GROUP BY B.customer_id , B.order_id ) WHERE price > 1000 AND price < 2000 GROUP BY customer_id ) GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

gold: SELECT customer_id FROM ( SELECT customer_id , COUNT ( * ) * ( 666 + 222 ) AS points FROM ( SELECT B.customer_id , B.order_id , B.order_date , SUM ( A.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS price FROM Order_Items A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON C.product_id = A.product_id GROUP BY B.customer_id , B.order_id ) WHERE price > 2000 GROUP BY customer_id UNION SELECT customer_id , COUNT ( * ) * 222 AS points FROM ( SELECT B.customer_id , B.order_id , B.order_date , SUM ( A.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS price FROM Order_Items A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON C.product_id = A.product_id GROUP BY B.customer_id , B.order_id ) WHERE price > 1000 AND price < 2000 GROUP BY customer_id ) GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

question: 给出销售量最高的产品的ID，名字，销量，以及给出其比销售量最低的产品的销售量高多少？
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.order_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(oi.order_quantity) - (SELECT MIN(qty) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi2.order_quantity) AS qty FROM Order_Items AS oi2 GROUP BY oi2.product_id)) AS diff_min FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT t1.product_id , t1.product_name , MAX ( t1.quantity ) AS max_quantity , t2.diff FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( quantity ) - MIN ( quantity ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) ) t2

question: 给出销售量最高的产品的ID，名字。假如它的销售量又增加了500，它的销售量变成了多少，其比销售量最低的产品的销售量高多少？
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.order_quantity) + 500 AS new_quantity, (SUM(oi.order_quantity) + 500) - (SELECT MIN(total_qty) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi2.order_quantity) AS total_qty FROM Order_Items AS oi2 GROUP BY oi2.product_id)) AS diff_from_min FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.order_quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT t1.product_id , t1.product_name , MAX ( t1.quantity ) + 500 AS max_quantity , t2.diff + 500 FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( quantity ) - MIN ( quantity ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) ) t2

question: 销量第一的产品的ID和名字是什么？假设它的销量增加500，它的销量是多少，比销量倒数第一的产品销量高多少？
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.order_quantity) + 500 AS new_sales, (SELECT SUM(oi2.order_quantity) FROM Order_Items AS oi2 WHERE oi2.product_id = p.product_id) + 500 - (SELECT MIN(sales) FROM (SELECT product_id, SUM(order_quantity) AS sales FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY sales ASC LIMIT 1)) AS diff_from_last FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.order_quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT t1.product_id , t1.product_name , MAX ( t1.quantity ) + 500 AS max_quantity , t2.diff + 500 FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( quantity ) - MIN ( quantity ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) ) t2

question: 使用信用卡付款需要交支付金额5%的手续费。列出每个客户的姓名，其每笔订单的id，以及每笔订单共花了多少钱。
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, co.order_id, SUM(oi.order_quantity * p.product_price) * 1.05 AS total_spent FROM Customers AS c JOIN Customer_Orders AS co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.payment_method_code = 'credit_card' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, co.order_id LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.customer_name , B.order_id , ( C.order_quantity * D.product_price ) * ( 1 + 5.0 / 100 ) AS cost_plus_fee FROM Customers A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id JOIN Order_Items C ON B.order_id = C.order_id JOIN Products D ON C.product_id = D.product_id WHERE A.payment_method_code = "Credit Card" GROUP BY A.customer_name , B.order_id UNION SELECT A.customer_name , B.order_id , C.order_quantity * D.product_price AS cost_plus_fee FROM Customers A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id JOIN Order_Items C ON B.order_id = C.order_id JOIN Products D ON C.product_id = D.product_id WHERE A.payment_method_code != "Credit Card" GROUP BY A.customer_name , B.order_id

question: 列出年份和对应的年销售额。
sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', order_date) AS year, SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL) * p.product_price) AS annual_sales FROM Customer_Orders AS co JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY year LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT strftime ( "%Y" , A.order_date ) AS year , SUM ( B.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS annual_sales_revenue FROM Customer_Orders A JOIN Order_Items B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON B.product_id = C.product_id GROUP BY strftime ( "%Y" , A.order_date )

question: 列出苹果产品的最高价、最低价、方差。
sql: SELECT MAX(product_price) AS max_price, MIN(product_price) AS min_price, (SUM(product_price * product_price) - SUM(product_price) * SUM(product_price) / COUNT(*)) / COUNT(*) AS variance FROM Products WHERE product_name LIKE '%苹果%' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT max_price , min_price , variance FROM ( SELECT 1.0 * ( product_price - AVG ( product_price ) ) * ( product_price - AVG ( product_price ) ) / COUNT ( * ) AS variance FROM Products WHERE product_name = "Apple" ) JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( product_price ) AS max_price , MIN ( product_price ) AS min_price FROM Products WHERE product_name = "Apple" )

question: 苹果产品的最高价、最低价、价格方差是多少？
sql: SELECT MAX(product_price) AS max_price, MIN(product_price) AS min_price, AVG((product_price - (SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM Products WHERE product_name LIKE '%苹果%')) * (product_price - (SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM Products WHERE product_name LIKE '%苹果%'))) AS price_variance FROM Products WHERE product_name LIKE '%苹果%' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT max_price , min_price , variance FROM ( SELECT 1.0 * ( product_price - AVG ( product_price ) ) * ( product_price - AVG ( product_price ) ) / COUNT ( * ) AS variance FROM Products WHERE product_name = "Apple" ) JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( product_price ) AS max_price , MIN ( product_price ) AS min_price FROM Products WHERE product_name = "Apple" )

question: 列出每个客户的ID和报名驾校时的年龄。

question: 列出入职时大于20岁的教练的ID和安排的课程数量。
sql: SELECT s.staff_id, COUNT(l.lesson_id) AS lesson_count FROM Staff AS s JOIN Lessons AS l ON s.staff_id = l.staff_id WHERE (STRFTIME('%Y', s.date_joined_staff) - STRFTIME('%Y', s.date_of_birth)) > 20 OR ((STRFTIME('%Y', s.date_joined_staff) - STRFTIME('%Y', s.date_of_birth) = 20) AND (STRFTIME('%m%d', s.date_joined_staff) >= STRFTIME('%m%d', s.date_of_birth))) GROUP BY s.staff_id LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.staff_id, COUNT (*) AS n_lesson FROM Staff A JOIN Lessons B ON A.staff_id = B.staff_id WHERE strftime ("%Y", A.date_joined_staff) - strftime ("%Y", A.date_of_birth) - (strftime ("%m-%d", A.date_joined_staff) < strftime ("%m-%d", A.date_of_birth)) > 20 UNION ALL SELECT staff_id, 0 AS n_lesson FROM Staff WHERE strftime ("%Y", date_joined_staff) - strftime ("%Y", date_of_birth) - (strftime ("%m-%d", date_joined_staff) < strftime ("%m-%d", date_of_birth)) > 20 AND staff_id NOT IN (SELECT A.staff_id FROM Staff A JOIN Lessons B ON A.staff_id = B.staff_id)

gold: SELECT total, 1.0 * n_cancel / total AS ratio FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS total FROM Lessons WHERE staff_id = ( SELECT staff_id FROM Staff ORDER BY strftime ( "%Y" , date_left_staff ) - strftime ( "%Y" , date_of_birth ) - ( strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_left_staff ) < strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_of_birth ) ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_cancel FROM Lessons WHERE staff_id = ( SELECT staff_id FROM Staff ORDER BY strftime ( "%Y" , date_left_staff ) - strftime ( "%Y" , date_of_birth ) - ( strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_left_staff ) < strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_of_birth ) ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND lesson_status_code = "Cancelled" )

question: 假如所有教练入职后的60天内都没有课程安排，离开驾校的时年龄最大的教练总共有多少课程安排，其中被取消了的课占比多少？
sql: SELECT COUNT(L.lesson_id) AS total_lessons, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L.lesson_status_code = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(L.lesson_id) AS cancelled_ratio FROM Staff AS S JOIN Addresses AS A ON S.staff_address_id = A.address_id JOIN Lessons AS L ON S.staff_id = L.staff_id WHERE NOT S.date_left_staff IS NULL AND NOT S.staff_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT L2.staff_id FROM Lessons AS L2 WHERE L2.lesson_date BETWEEN S.date_joined_staff AND DATE(S.date_joined_staff, '+60 days')) AND NOT S.date_left_staff IS NULL ORDER BY (STRFTIME('%Y', S.date_left_staff) - STRFTIME('%Y', S.date_of_birth) - (STRFTIME('%m%d', S.date_left_staff) < STRFTIME('%m%d', S.date_of_birth))) DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT total, 1.0 * n_cancel / total AS ratio FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS total FROM Lessons A JOIN Staff B ON A.staff_id = B.staff_id WHERE A.staff_id = ( SELECT staff_id FROM Staff ORDER BY strftime ( "%Y" , date_left_staff ) - strftime ( "%Y" , date_of_birth ) - ( strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_left_staff ) < strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_of_birth ) ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND A.lesson_date > strftime ( julianday ( B.date_joined_staff ) + 60 ) ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_cancel FROM Lessons A JOIN Staff B ON A.staff_id = B.staff_id WHERE A.staff_id = ( SELECT staff_id FROM Staff ORDER BY strftime ( "%Y" , date_left_staff ) - strftime ( "%Y" , date_of_birth ) - ( strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_left_staff ) < strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_of_birth ) ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND A.lesson_status_code = "Cancelled" AND A.lesson_date > strftime ( julianday ( B.date_joined_staff ) + 60 ) )

question: 哪个客户支付的钱最多，给出他的ID，并求出其比支付的钱最少的客户多支付多少钱。
sql: SELECT (SELECT customer_id FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(amount_payment) DESC LIMIT 1) AS max_payer_id, (SELECT SUM(amount_payment) FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(amount_payment) DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT SUM(amount_payment) FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(amount_payment) ASC LIMIT 1) AS difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.customer_id , MAX ( A.amount_payment ) - ( SELECT MIN ( amount_payment ) FROM Customer_Payments ) AS payment_diff FROM Customer_Payments A JOIN Customers B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id

question: 列出付钱最多的客户的ID，以及其比付钱最少的客户多付的钱的数额。
sql: SELECT (SELECT customer_id FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(amount_payment) DESC LIMIT 1) AS max_customer_id, (SELECT SUM(amount_payment) FROM Customer_Payments WHERE customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(amount_payment) DESC LIMIT 1)) - (SELECT SUM(amount_payment) FROM Customer_Payments WHERE customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(amount_payment) ASC LIMIT 1)) AS amount_difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.customer_id , MAX ( A.amount_payment ) - ( SELECT MIN ( amount_payment ) FROM Customer_Payments ) AS payment_diff FROM Customer_Payments A JOIN Customers B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id

question: 假如阿米娅·斯宾卡2018年3月12日多支付5000，哪个客户支付的钱最多，给出他的ID，并求出其比支付的钱最少的客户多支付多少钱。

gold: SELECT customer_id, MAX (amount_payment) - (SELECT MIN (amount_payment) FROM (SELECT A.customer_id, amount_payment + 5000 AS amount_payment FROM Customer_Payments A JOIN Customers B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id WHERE B.first_name = "Amya" AND B.last_name = "Spinka" AND strftime ("%Y-%m-%d", A.datetime_payment) = "2018-03-12" UNION ALL SELECT A.customer_id, amount_payment + 5000 AS amount_payment FROM Customer_Payments A JOIN Customers B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id WHERE NOT (B.first_name = "Amya" AND B.last_name = "Spinka" AND strftime ("%Y-%m-%d", A.datetime_payment) = "2018-03-12") )) AS payment_diff FROM (SELECT A.customer_id, amount_payment + 5000 AS amount_payment FROM Customer_Payments A JOIN Customers B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id WHERE B.first_name = "Amya" AND B.last_name = "Spinka" AND strftime ("%Y-%m-%d", A.datetime_payment) = "2018-03-12" UNION ALL SELECT A.customer_id, amount_payment + 5000 AS amount_payment FROM Customer_Payments A JOIN Customers B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id WHERE NOT (B.first_name = "Amya" AND B.last_name = "Spinka" AND strftime ("%Y-%m-%d", A.datetime_payment) = "2018-03-12") )

question: 贾妮莎·阿马拉·萨文离职5年后多少岁，比卡梅尔·伊西·魏斯纳特小多少岁？

gold: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 5 + strftime ( "%Y" , date_left_staff ) - strftime ( "%Y" , date_of_birth ) - ( strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_left_staff ) < strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_of_birth ) ) AS age FROM Staff WHERE first_name = "Janessa" AND middle_name = "Amara" AND last_name = "Sawayn" ) JOIN ( SELECT date_of_birth - ( SELECT date_of_birth FROM Staff WHERE first_name = "Janessa" AND middle_name = "Amara" AND last_name = "Sawayn" ) AS diff FROM Staff WHERE first_name = "Camylle" AND middle_name = "Icie" AND last_name = "Weissnat" )

question: 在2009年澳大利亚大奖赛资格赛中，排名第一的车手在三场比赛中的平均圈速是多少？
sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(q.q1, 2) AS REAL) + CAST(SUBSTRING(q.q2, 2) AS REAL) + CAST(SUBSTRING(q.q3, 2) AS REAL)) / 3.0 FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2009 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND q.position = 1 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT time ( ( strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || q1 ) + strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || q2 ) + strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || q3 ) ) / 3.0 , "unixepoch" ) AS avg_lap FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId WHERE B.name = "Australian Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2009" AND A.position = "1"

question: 在2009年澳大利亚大奖赛资格赛中排名最高的车手三场比赛的平均圈速是多少？
sql: SELECT AVG(lapTimes.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes JOIN races ON lapTimes.raceId = races.raceId JOIN qualifying ON lapTimes.raceId = qualifying.raceId AND lapTimes.driverId = qualifying.driverId WHERE races.year = 2009 AND races.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND qualifying.position <= 3 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT time ( ( strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || q1 ) + strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || q2 ) + strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || q3 ) ) / 3.0 , "unixepoch" ) AS avg_lap FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId WHERE B.name = "Australian Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2009" AND A.position = "1"

question: 在2009年澳大利亚大奖赛资格赛中，排名第一的车手在三场比赛中的平均圈速是多少，假设他在q1中的圈速是1:26.026？
sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, 1, INSTR(q1, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) AS avg_q1_seconds FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2009 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND q.position = 1 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT time ( ( strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || "1:26.026" ) + strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || q2 ) + strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || q3 ) ) / 3.0 , "unixepoch" ) AS avg_lap FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId WHERE B.name = "Australian Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2009" AND A.position = "1"

question: 如果在2009年澳大利亚大奖赛资格赛中排名最高的车手在q1中的圈速是1:26.026，那他三场比赛中的平均圈速是多少？
sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, 1, INSTR(q1, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) AS avg_q1_time FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2009 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND q.position = 1 AND q.q1 = '1:26.026' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT time ( ( strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || "1:26.026" ) + strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || q2 ) + strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || q3 ) ) / 3.0 , "unixepoch" ) AS avg_lap FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId WHERE B.name = "Australian Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2009" AND A.position = "1"

question: 2009年和2010年分别举行了多少场比赛？它们相差多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2009, SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2010, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS difference FROM races WHERE year IN (2009, 2010) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT n_2009 , n_2010 , ABS ( n_2009 - n_2010 ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_2009 FROM races WHERE year = "2009" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_2010 FROM races WHERE year = "2010" )

question: 分别列出在2009年和2010年举行的比赛数量，以及二者的差距。
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2009, SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2010, SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM races LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT n_2009 , n_2010 , ABS ( n_2009 - n_2010 ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_2009 FROM races WHERE year = "2009" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_2010 FROM races WHERE year = "2010" )

question: 2009年和2010年分别举行了多少场比赛？它们相差多少假如2010年再多举行了5场比赛？
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS year_2009_count, SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS year_2010_count, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 5)) AS difference_with_extra_5 FROM races WHERE year IN (2009, 2010) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT n_2009 , n_2010 + 5 , ABS ( n_2010 + 5 - n_2009 ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_2009 FROM races WHERE year = "2009" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_2010 FROM races WHERE year = "2010" )

question: 如果2010年再多举办5场比赛，分别列出在2009年和2010年举行的比赛数量，以及二者的差距。
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE year = 2009) AS count_2009, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE year = 2010) AS count_2010, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE year = 2010) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE year = 2009) AS difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT n_2009 , n_2010 + 5 , ABS ( n_2010 + 5 - n_2009 ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_2009 FROM races WHERE year = "2009" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_2010 FROM races WHERE year = "2010" )

question: 法国比意大利多举行了多少场比赛？

gold: SELECT n_france - n_italy FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_france FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE B.Country = "France" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_italy FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE B.Country = "Italy" )

question: 在法国举办的比赛数量比在意大利举办的比赛数量多多少？

question: 北半球和南半球分别举行了多少场比赛？它们相差多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN lat >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS northern_count, SUM(CASE WHEN lat < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS southern_count, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN lat >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN lat < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS difference FROM circuits AS c JOIN races AS r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT n_north , n_south , n_north - n_south FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_north FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE B.lat > 0 ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_south FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE B.lat < 0 )

question: 分别列出举办位置在北半球和南半球的比赛数量，以及二者的差距。
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN lat >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS north_count, SUM(CASE WHEN lat < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS south_count, SUM(CASE WHEN lat >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN lat < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM circuits AS c JOIN races AS r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT n_north , n_south , n_north - n_south FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_north FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE B.lat > 0 ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_south FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE B.lat < 0 )

question: 在2006年英国大奖赛资格赛第一轮比赛中，给出速度最快、最慢的车手的姓，名，以及他们圈速的差距。
sql: SELECT d1.surname AS fastest_surname, d1.forename AS fastest_forename, d2.surname AS slowest_surname, d2.forename AS slowest_forename, (CAST(SUBSTRING(q2.q1, 6) AS REAL) - CAST(SUBSTRING(q1.q1, 6) AS REAL)) * 1000 AS gap_milliseconds FROM qualifying AS q1 JOIN drivers AS d1 ON q1.driverId = d1.driverId JOIN qualifying AS q2 ON TRUE JOIN drivers AS d2 ON q2.driverId = d2.driverId JOIN races AS r ON q1.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2006 AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix' AND q1.position = 1 AND q2.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM qualifying AS q3 JOIN races AS r2 ON q3.raceId = r2.raceId WHERE r2.year = 2006 AND r2.name = 'British Grand Prix' AND NOT q3.position IS NULL) AND q1.raceId = q2.raceId AND NOT q1.q1 IS NULL AND NOT q2.q1 IS NULL LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT forename_slowest , surname_slowest , forename_fastest , surname_fastest , time ( ( strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || slowest_q1 ) - strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || fastest_q1 ) ) , "unixepoch" ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT MAX ( A.q1 ) AS slowest_q1 , D.forename AS forename_slowest , D.surname AS surname_slowest FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId JOIN drivers D ON A.driverId = D.driverId WHERE B.name = "British Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2006" ) JOIN ( SELECT MIN ( A.q1 ) AS fastest_q1 , D.forename AS forename_fastest , D.surname AS surname_fastest FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId JOIN drivers D ON A.driverId = D.driverId WHERE B.name = "British Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2006" AND A.q1 != "" )

question: 列出2006年英国大奖赛资格赛第一轮比赛中速度最快和最慢的车手的姓，名，以及他们圈速的差距。
sql: SELECT d1.surname AS slowest_surname, d1.forename AS slowest_forename, d2.surname AS fastest_surname, d2.forename AS fastest_forename, (t1.q1_seconds - t2.q1_seconds) AS time_gap FROM qualifying AS q1 JOIN drivers AS d1 ON q1.driverId = d1.driverId JOIN races AS r ON q1.raceId = r.raceId JOIN (SELECT driverId, CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, 1, INSTR(q1 || ' ', ' ') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 1, IIF(INSTR(SUBSTRING(q1 || ' ', INSTR(q1, ':')), ' ') = 0, 0, INSTR(SUBSTRING(q1 || ' ', INSTR(q1, ':')), ' ') + INSTR(q1, ':') - 1) - INSTR(q1, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 4) AS REAL) AS q1_seconds FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2006 AND name = 'British Grand Prix')) AS t1 ON q1.driverId = t1.driverId JOIN (SELECT driverId, CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, 1, INSTR(q1 || ' ', ' ') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 1, IIF(INSTR(SUBSTRING(q1 || ' ', INSTR(q1, ':')), ' ') = 0, 0, INSTR(SUBSTRING(q1 || ' ', INSTR(q1, ':')), ' ') + INSTR(q1, ':') - 1) - INSTR(q1, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 4) AS REAL) AS q1_seconds FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2006 AND name = 'British Grand Prix')) AS t2 ON t2.q1_seconds = (SELECT MIN(CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, 1, INSTR(q1 || ' ', ' ') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 1, IIF(INSTR(SUBSTRING(q1 || ' ', INSTR(q1, ':')), ' ') = 0, 0, INSTR(SUBSTRING(q1 || ' ', INSTR(q1, ':')), ' ') + INSTR(q1, ':') - 1) - INSTR(q1, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(q1, INSTR(q1, ':') + 4) AS REAL)) FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2006 AND name = 'British Grand Prix')) JOIN drivers AS d2 ON t2.driverId = d2.driverId WHERE q1.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2006 AND name = 'British Grand Prix') ORDER BY t1.q1_seconds DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT forename_slowest , surname_slowest , forename_fastest , surname_fastest , time ( ( strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || slowest_q1 ) - strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || fastest_q1 ) ) , "unixepoch" ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT MAX ( A.q1 ) AS slowest_q1 , D.forename AS forename_slowest , D.surname AS surname_slowest FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId JOIN drivers D ON A.driverId = D.driverId WHERE B.name = "British Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2006" ) JOIN ( SELECT MIN ( A.q1 ) AS fastest_q1 , D.forename AS forename_fastest , D.surname AS surname_fastest FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId JOIN drivers D ON A.driverId = D.driverId WHERE B.name = "British Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2006" AND A.q1 != "" )

question: 如果最低圈速记录为93000毫秒，请列出圈速超过最低圈速记录1.5倍的驾驶员姓和名。

question: 若最低圈速纪录是93000毫秒，那哪些车手的圈速超过最低圈速记录1.5倍？列出他们的姓和名。

question: 列出比赛次数比葡萄牙首都的比赛次数的三倍多的地点和比赛次数。
sql: SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY location HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT 3 * COUNT(*) FROM races AS r2 JOIN circuits AS c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId WHERE c2.country = 'Portugal' AND c2.location = 'Lisbon') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.location , COUNT ( * ) AS num_races FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId GROUP BY B.location HAVING COUNT ( * ) > 3 * ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE B.location = "Lisbon" )

question: 哪些地点举办的比赛数量比葡萄牙首都的比赛次数的三倍还要多？列出这些地点和他们举办的比赛次数。
sql: SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY location HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT 3 * COUNT(*) FROM races AS r2 JOIN circuits AS c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId WHERE c2.country = 'Portugal' AND c2.location = 'Lisbon') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.location , COUNT ( * ) AS num_races FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId GROUP BY B.location HAVING COUNT ( * ) > 3 * ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE B.location = "Lisbon" )

question: 如果在里斯本举行了5场比赛，列出比赛次数比葡萄牙首都的比赛次数的三倍多的地点和比赛次数。
sql: SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.location <> 'Lisbon' /* 排除里斯本 */ GROUP BY c.location HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races AS r2 JOIN circuits AS c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId WHERE c2.location = 'Lisbon') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.location , COUNT ( * ) AS num_races FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId GROUP BY B.location HAVING COUNT ( * ) > 3 * 5

question: 如果里斯本举行的比赛数量为5场，那么哪些地点举办的比赛数量比葡萄牙首都的比赛次数的三倍还要多？列出这些地点和他们举办的比赛次数。
sql: SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Portugal' AND c.location <> 'Lisbon' GROUP BY c.location HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races AS r2 JOIN circuits AS c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId WHERE c2.location = 'Lisbon' AND c2.country = 'Portugal') * 3 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.location , COUNT ( * ) AS num_races FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId GROUP BY B.location HAVING COUNT ( * ) > 3 * 5

question: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿参加了多少场比赛？他有多少次获得了第一名？他获得第一名的概率是多少？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_races, SUM(CASE WHEN r.positionText = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_places, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.positionText = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS win_probability FROM results AS r JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT num_matches , num_no1 , 1.0 * num_no1 / num_matches AS possibility FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS num_matches FROM results A JOIN drivers B ON A.driverId = B.driverId WHERE B.surname = "Albers" AND B.forename = "Christijan" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS num_no1 FROM results A JOIN drivers B ON A.driverId = B.driverId WHERE B.surname = "Hamilton" AND B.forename = "Lewis" AND A.rank = "1" )

question: 列出刘易斯·汉密尔顿参加的比赛数量，获得第一名的次数，以及获得冠军的概率。
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_races, SUM(CASE WHEN rs.position = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.position = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS win_probability FROM results AS rs JOIN drivers AS d ON rs.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT num_matches , num_no1 , 1.0 * num_no1 / num_matches AS possibility FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS num_matches FROM results A JOIN drivers B ON A.driverId = B.driverId WHERE B.surname = "Albers" AND B.forename = "Christijan" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS num_no1 FROM results A JOIN drivers B ON A.driverId = B.driverId WHERE B.surname = "Hamilton" AND B.forename = "Lewis" AND A.rank = "1" )

question: 美国的赛道数量是世界上陆地面积最大的国家的多少倍？

question: 请给出位于美国的赛道数量是位于世界上陆地面积最大的国家的赛道数量的多少倍。

gold: SELECT 1.0 * ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM circuits WHERE country = "USA" ) / COUNT ( * ) AS ratio FROM circuits WHERE country = "Russia"

question: 假设美国有2个赛道，美国的赛道数量是世界上陆地面积最大的国家的多少倍？

gold: SELECT 1.0 * 2 / COUNT ( * ) AS ratio FROM circuits WHERE country = "Russia"

question: 如果美国的赛道数量为2，请给出位于美国的赛道数量是位于世界上陆地面积最大的国家的赛道数量的多少倍。
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits WHERE country = 'USA') * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Russia') AS ratio LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * 2 / COUNT ( * ) AS ratio FROM circuits WHERE country = "Russia"

question: 在与著名足球运动员克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多拥有相同国籍的车手中，参加过2006年美国大奖赛的选手是没有参加过的选手的多少倍？
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT r.raceId IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN r.raceId IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS ratio FROM drivers AS d JOIN circuits AS c ON c.country = d.nationality JOIN races AS ra ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId AND ra.year = 2006 AND ra.name = 'United States Grand Prix' LEFT JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId AND r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE d.nationality = (SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Cristiano' AND surname = 'Ronaldo' LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * n_p / n_all FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT A.driverId ) AS n_p FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId JOIN races C ON B.raceId = C.raceID WHERE A.nationality = "Portuguese" AND C.name = "United States Grand Prix" AND C.year = "2006" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT A.driverId ) AS n_all FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId JOIN races C ON B.raceId = C.raceID WHERE A.nationality = "Portuguese" )

question: 国籍与著名足球运动员克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多相同的赛车手中，参加过2006年美国大奖赛的选手数量是没有参加过的选手数量的多少倍？

question: 在乔治·W·布什担任总统期间，美国举办了多少场比赛？是英国举办的比赛的多少倍？

gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE A.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND country = "UK" ) AS ratio FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE A.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND country = "USA"

question: 美国在乔治·W·布什担任总统期间举办的比赛数量是多少？是英国同期举办比赛数量的多少倍？

question: 在乔治·布什担任总统期间，美国举办了多少场比赛？是英国举办的比赛的多少倍，假如英国那段时间举办了10次比赛？

question: 美国在乔治·W·布什担任总统期间举办的比赛数量是多少？是英国举办比赛数量的多少倍，假设英国在这段时间举办了10次比赛？

question: 请提供参加过的比赛次数至少是艾伦·伯格的两倍且与著名的歌手迈克尔·杰克逊具有相同国籍的车手的ID、名字、比赛次数。
sql: SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, COUNT(r.resultId) AS race_count FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE d.nationality = (SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Michael' AND surname = 'Jackson') AND d.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Alan' AND surname = 'Berg') GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename HAVING COUNT(r.resultId) >= 2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Alan' AND surname = 'Berg')) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.driverId , forename AS first_name , COUNT ( * ) AS n_races FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId GROUP BY A.driverId HAVING COUNT ( * ) >= 2 * ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId WHERE A.forename = "Allen" AND A.surname = "Berg" ) AND A.nationality = "American"

question: 给出国籍与著名的歌手迈克尔·杰克逊具有相同，且参加过比赛的数量不少于艾伦·伯格的两倍的车手的ID、名字和参加过比赛次数。

question: 假设艾伦·伯格参加了10场比赛，请提供参加过的比赛次数至少是艾伦·伯格的两倍且与著名的歌手迈克尔·约瑟夫·杰克逊具有相同国籍的车手的ID、名字、比赛次数。

question: 假设艾伦·伯格参加过的比赛的数量是10，给出国籍与著名的歌手迈克尔·杰克逊具有相同，且参加过比赛的数量不少于艾伦·伯格的两倍的车手的ID、名字和参加过比赛次数。
sql: SELECT d.driverId, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS name, COUNT(r.resultId) AS race_count FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE d.nationality = (SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Alan' AND surname = 'Jones') AND d.driverId <> (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Alan' AND surname = 'Jones') GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultId) >= 2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Alan' AND surname = 'Jones')) LIMIT 1

question: 约翰·史密斯住了几天院？

question: 使用了Foo Labs品牌的药的病人比使用了Baz Industries品牌的药的病人多多少？

question: 假如总共有10位病人使用过Foo Labs品牌的药品，那么使用过品牌为Foo Labs的药物的病人的数量比用过品牌位Baz Industries的药物的病人数量多多少？

question: 预约次数最多的医生的预约次数是预约次数最少的医生的多少倍？

question: 如果预约最少的医师新添了2个预约，预约次数最多的医生的预约次数是他的多少倍？

question: 如果预约数量垫底的医师新添了2个预约，那预约次数排名第一的医生的预约次数是他的多少倍？

question: 所有药物每剂2美元。Dennis Doe在药物和治疗上总共花了多少钱？

gold: SELECT med_cost + pro_cost AS total_cost FROM ( SELECT 2 * SUM ( A.dose ) AS med_cost FROM Prescribes A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "Dennis Doe" ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( COST ) AS pro_cost FROM Procedures A JOIN Undergoes B ON A.Code = B.Procedures JOIN Patient C ON B.Patient = C.SSN WHERE C.name = "Dennis Doe" )

question: 所有药物每剂2美元。假如丹尼斯·多伊2008年4月30日16:53多买了10剂Thesisin，他在药物和治疗上总共花了多少钱？

gold: SELECT med_cost + pro_cost + 10 * 2 AS total_cost FROM ( SELECT 2 * SUM ( A.dose ) AS med_cost FROM Prescribes A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "Dennis Doe" AND A.Date != "2008-04-30 16:53" ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( COST ) AS pro_cost FROM Procedures A JOIN Undergoes B ON A.Code = B.Procedures JOIN Patient C ON B.Patient = C.SSN WHERE C.name = "Dennis Doe" )

question: 如果任何药物都是2美元一剂，假如丹尼斯·多伊2008年4月30日16:53多购买了10剂Thesisin，那么Dennis Doe在药物和治疗上的总花费是多少？

gold: SELECT med_cost + pro_cost + 10 * 2 AS total_cost FROM ( SELECT 2 * SUM ( A.dose ) AS med_cost FROM Prescribes A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "Dennis Doe" AND A.Date != "2008-04-30 16:53" ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( COST ) AS pro_cost FROM Procedures A JOIN Undergoes B ON A.Code = B.Procedures JOIN Patient C ON B.Patient = C.SSN WHERE C.name = "Dennis Doe" )

question: John Wen 接受培训过的手术资格认证的有效期是多长？

question: 同时属于外科部门和普通内科部门的医生在属于外科的医生中所占的比例是多少？
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s1.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'Surgery') AND s2.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'General Internal Medicine') THEN s1.Physician END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'Surgery') THEN s.Physician END) AS ratio FROM Affiliated_With AS s LEFT JOIN Affiliated_With AS s1 ON s.Physician = s1.Physician LEFT JOIN Affiliated_With AS s2 ON s1.Physician = s2.Physician WHERE s.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'Surgery') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM Affiliated_With WHERE Department = ( SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = "Surgery" ) ) AS prop FROM ( select * from Affiliated_With as A join department as B on A.Department = B.DepartmentID WHERE B.Name = "Surgery" or B.Name = "General Medicine" GROUP BY Physician HAVING COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.Name ) ) = 2 )

question: 在外科和普通内科两个部门同时工作的医生所占外科医生的比例是多少？
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d1.Name = 'Surgery' AND d2.Name = 'General Internal Medicine' THEN p1.EmployeeID END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d1.Name = 'Surgery' THEN p1.EmployeeID END) AS ratio FROM Physician AS p1 JOIN Affiliated_With AS a1 ON p1.EmployeeID = a1.Physician JOIN Department AS d1 ON a1.Department = d1.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN Affiliated_With AS a2 ON p1.EmployeeID = a2.Physician AND a2.PrimaryAffiliation = 0 LEFT JOIN Department AS d2 ON a2.Department = d2.DepartmentID WHERE d1.Name = 'Surgery' AND (d2.Name = 'General Internal Medicine' OR d2.Name IS NULL) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM Affiliated_With WHERE Department = ( SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = "Surgery" ) ) AS prop FROM ( select * from Affiliated_With as A join department as B on A.Department = B.DepartmentID WHERE B.Name = "Surgery" or B.Name = "General Medicine" GROUP BY Physician HAVING COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.Name ) ) = 2 )

question: 假如基思·杜德米斯特既属于外科部门又属于普通内科部门，同时属于外科部门和普通内科部门的医生在属于外科的医生中所占的比例是多少？
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.Name IN ('Surgery', 'General Internal Medicine') THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM Physician AS p JOIN Affiliated_With AS a ON p.EmployeeID = a.Physician JOIN Department AS d ON a.Department = d.DepartmentID WHERE p.Name = 'Keith Dudmyst' AND a.PrimaryAffiliation = 1 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * ( 1 + COUNT ( * ) ) / ( 1 + ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM Affiliated_With as A join Physician as B on A.Physician = B.EmployeeID WHERE B.Name != "Keith Dudermeister" and Department = ( SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = "Surgery" ) ) ) AS prop FROM ( select * from Affiliated_With as A join department as B on A.Department = B.DepartmentID join Physician as C on A.Physician = C.EmployeeID WHERE C.Name != "Keith Dudermeister" and ( B.Name = "Surgery" or B.Name = "General Medicine" ) GROUP BY Physician HAVING COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.Name ) ) = 2 )

question: 假如基思·杜德米斯特既在外科部门工作又在普通内科部门工作，那么在外科和普通内科两个部门同时工作的医生所占外科医生的比例是多少？

gold: SELECT 1.0 * ( 1 + COUNT ( * ) ) / ( 1 + ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM Affiliated_With as A join Physician as B on A.Physician = B.EmployeeID WHERE B.Name != "Keith Dudermeister" and Department = ( SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = "Surgery" ) ) ) AS prop FROM ( select * from Affiliated_With as A join department as B on A.Department = B.DepartmentID join Physician as C on A.Physician = C.EmployeeID WHERE C.Name != "Keith Dudermeister" and ( B.Name = "Surgery" or B.Name = "General Medicine" ) GROUP BY Physician HAVING COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.Name ) ) = 2 )

question: 如果每个治疗都涨价50%，那么丹尼斯·多伊消费最高的一次治疗和消费最低的一次治疗相差多少钱？

question: 如果一枚金牌可以获得5个积分，一枚大银牌获得3分，一枚小银牌获得2分，一枚铜牌获得1分。获得最多积分的俱乐部位于哪里，成立于哪年，有几个男教练，女教练？
sql: SELECT c.Region, c.Start_year, SUM(CASE WHEN co.Gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_coaches, SUM(CASE WHEN co.Gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_coaches FROM club AS c JOIN match_result AS mr ON c.Club_ID = mr.Club_ID JOIN coach AS co ON c.Club_ID = co.Club_ID GROUP BY c.Club_ID, c.Region, c.Start_year ORDER BY (mr.Gold * 5 + mr.Big_Silver * 3 + mr.Small_Silver * 2 + mr.Bronze * 1) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 传球得分包括5%的弧线球、5%的任意球精度、15%的长传、20%的传中、20%的视野和35%的短传。列出传球得分最高的前10名球员的姓名和当前年龄。
sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CAST((strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.birthday)) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(date) 
    FROM Player_Attributes 
    WHERE player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
)
ORDER BY (
    0.05 * pa.curve +
    0.05 * pa.free_kick_accuracy +
    0.15 * pa.long_passing +
    0.20 * pa.crossing +
    0.20 * pa.vision +
    0.35 * pa.short_passing
) DESC
LIMIT 10;
gold: SELECT name , age FROM ( SELECT B.player_name AS name , MAX ( 0.05 * A.curve + 0.05 * A.free_kick_accuracy + 0.15 * A.long_passing + 0.2 * A.crossing + 0.2 * A.vision + 0.35 * A.short_passing ) AS passing_rating , DATE ( "now" ) - strftime ( "%Y-%m-%d" , B.birthday ) AS age FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ORDER BY passing_rating DESC LIMIT 10 )
