question: 射门评分由5个属性组成，包括45%的射门精度、20%的远射、5%的点球、5%的跑位、20%的射门力量和5%的凌空射门。如果把所有球员射门属性中的最薄弱一项提高五分，那么射门评分最高的球员的名字和评分是多少？
sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(
        0.45 * (CASE WHEN pa.finishing = least_val THEN pa.finishing + 5 ELSE pa.finishing END) +
        0.20 * (CASE WHEN pa.long_shots = least_val THEN pa.long_shots + 5 ELSE pa.long_shots END) +
        0.05 * (CASE WHEN pa.penalties = least_val THEN pa.penalties + 5 ELSE pa.penalties END) +
        0.05 * (CASE WHEN pa.positioning = least_val THEN pa.positioning + 5 ELSE pa.positioning END) +
        0.20 * (CASE WHEN pa.shot_power = least_val THEN pa.shot_power + 5 ELSE pa.shot_power END) +
        0.05 * (CASE WHEN pa.volleys = least_val THEN pa.volleys + 5 ELSE pa.volleys END)
    ) AS improved_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        MIN(val) AS least_val
    FROM (
        SELECT MIN(finishing) AS val FROM Player_Attributes WHERE finishing IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT MIN(long_shots) AS val FROM Player_Attributes WHERE long_shots IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT MIN(penalties) AS val FROM Player_Attributes WHERE penalties IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT MIN(positioning) AS val FROM Player_Attributes WHERE positioning IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT MIN(shot_power) AS val FROM Player_Attributes WHERE shot_power IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT MIN(volleys) AS val FROM Player_Attributes WHERE volleys IS NOT NULL
    )
) min_least
WHERE pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(date) 
    FROM Player_Attributes 
    WHERE player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id
)
ORDER BY improved_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold: SELECT 1.2 * SUM ( A.Cases ) * 12 / 1000 AS tons FROM wine A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE A.Year = "2005" AND B.Color = "Red"

question: 酿造一瓶红葡萄酒需要1.2千克的葡萄。假如帕洛玛酒厂2005年没有生产葡萄酒，2005年生产的红葡萄酒用了多少吨葡萄？
sql: SELECT SUM(w.Cases * 1.2 / 1000) AS total_tons FROM wine AS w JOIN grapes AS g ON w.Grape = g.Grape WHERE w.Winery = 'Paloma' AND w.Year = 2005 AND g.Color = 'Red' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.2 * SUM ( A.Cases ) * 12 / 1000 AS tons FROM wine A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE A.Year = "2005" AND B.Color = "Red" AND A.Winery != "Paloma"

question: 酿造一瓶葡萄酒需要1.2千克的葡萄。在纳帕县生产的葡萄酒一共用了多少吨红葡萄，多少吨白葡萄？
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.Color = 'Red' THEN w.Cases * 1.2 / 1000 ELSE 0 END) AS RedGrapeTons, SUM(CASE WHEN g.Color = 'White' THEN w.Cases * 1.2 / 1000 ELSE 0 END) AS WhiteGrapeTons FROM wine AS w JOIN grapes AS g ON w.Grape = g.Grape JOIN appellations AS a ON w.Appelation = a.Appelation WHERE a.County = 'Napa' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 1.2 * SUM ( A.Cases ) * 12 / 1000 AS tons_red FROM wine A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape JOIN appellations C ON A.Appelation = C.Appelation WHERE C.County = "Napa" AND B.Color = "Red" ) JOIN ( SELECT 1.2 * SUM ( A.Cases ) * 12 / 1000 AS tons_while FROM wine A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape JOIN appellations C ON A.Appelation = C.Appelation WHERE C.County = "Napa" AND B.Color = "White" )

question: 酿造一瓶葡萄酒需要1.2千克的葡萄。假如所有卡内罗斯葡萄酒的产区都不在纳帕县，产区在纳帕县的葡萄酒一共用了多少吨红葡萄，多少吨白葡萄？

question: 评分最高的赤霞珠葡萄酒来自哪些酒厂，它们的价格比赤霞珠葡萄酒的平均价高多少？

question: 假如2005年生产的全部酒的评分下降10分，评分最高的赤霞珠葡萄酒来自哪些酒厂，它们的价格比赤霞珠葡萄酒的平均价高多少？

question: 最贵的红葡萄酒比最贵的白葡萄酒贵多少？
sql: SELECT (SELECT MAX(w.Price) FROM wine AS w JOIN grapes AS g ON w.Grape = g.Grape WHERE g.Color = 'Red') - (SELECT MAX(w.Price) FROM wine AS w JOIN grapes AS g ON w.Grape = g.Grape WHERE g.Color = 'White') AS price_diff LIMIT 1000

question: 假如安培洛斯酒厂的酒降价20%，最贵的红葡萄酒比最贵的白葡萄酒贵多少？

question: 如果一个酒厂能做到连续3年生产的酒评分从未低于90，它就会被评为“优质酒厂”。有百分之多少的酒厂是优质酒厂？
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wine AS w2 WHERE w2.Winery = w1.Winery AND w2.Year BETWEEN w1.Year AND w1.Year + 2 GROUP BY w2.Winery, w2.Year HAVING MIN(w2.Score) >= 90 LIMIT 1) THEN w1.Winery END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT Winery) FROM wine AS w1 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) FROM wine ) AS percent FROM ( SELECT A.Winery , A.No , A.Year , A.Score , B.No , B.Year , B.Score , C.No , C.Year , C.Score FROM wine A JOIN wine B ON A.Winery = B.Winery JOIN wine C ON A.Winery = C.Winery WHERE A.Score >= 90 AND B.Score >= 90 AND C.Score >= 90 AND B.Year - A.Year = 1 AND C.Year - B.Year = 1 )

question: “优质酒厂”是连续3年生产的酒评分从未低于90的酒厂，那么所有酒厂中优质酒厂占多少百分比？
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t1.min_score >= 90 THEN t1.Winery END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT t2.Winery) AS percentage FROM (SELECT Winery, MIN(Score) AS min_score FROM wine GROUP BY Winery, Year) AS t1 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Winery FROM wine) AS t2 ON t1.Winery = t2.Winery LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) FROM wine ) AS percent FROM ( SELECT A.Winery , A.No , A.Year , A.Score , B.No , B.Year , B.Score , C.No , C.Year , C.Score FROM wine A JOIN wine B ON A.Winery = B.Winery JOIN wine C ON A.Winery = C.Winery WHERE A.Score >= 90 AND B.Score >= 90 AND C.Score >= 90 AND B.Year - A.Year = 1 AND C.Year - B.Year = 1 )

question: “优质酒厂”是连续3年生产的酒评分从未低于90的酒厂，假设用黑比诺葡萄酿造的葡萄酒评分降低5分，那么所有酒厂中优质酒厂占多少百分比？
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w1.Winery IN (SELECT Winery FROM wine WHERE Grape = '黑比诺' GROUP BY Winery HAVING MIN(Score - 5) >= 90 AND COUNT(DISTINCT Year) >= 3) THEN w1.Winery END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT w2.Winery) AS percentage FROM wine AS w1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Winery FROM wine) AS w2 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) FROM wine ) AS percent FROM ( SELECT A.Winery , A.No , A.Year , A.Score , B.No , B.Year , B.Score , C.No , C.Year , C.Score FROM ( SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score - 5 AS Score FROM wine WHERE Grape = "Pinot Noir" UNION ALL SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score FROM wine WHERE Grape != "Pinot Noir" ) A JOIN ( SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score - 5 AS Score FROM wine WHERE Grape = "Pinot Noir" UNION ALL SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score FROM wine WHERE Grape != "Pinot Noir" ) B ON A.Winery = B.Winery JOIN ( SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score - 5 AS Score FROM wine WHERE Grape = "Pinot Noir" UNION ALL SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score FROM wine WHERE Grape != "Pinot Noir" ) C ON A.Winery = C.Winery WHERE A.Score >= 90 AND B.Score >= 90 AND C.Score >= 90 AND B.Year - A.Year = 1 AND C.Year - B.Year = 1 )

question: 哪年白葡萄酒的产量最高，比当年红葡萄酒的产量高多少？
sql: SELECT w.Year, SUM(CASE WHEN g.Color = 'White' THEN w.Cases ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN g.Color = 'Red' THEN w.Cases ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM wine AS w JOIN grapes AS g ON w.Grape = g.Grape GROUP BY w.Year ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT Year , cases_white - cases_red AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.Year , SUM ( A.Cases ) AS cases_white FROM wine A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE B.Color = "White" GROUP BY A.Year ORDER BY SUM ( A.Cases ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( A.Cases ) AS cases_red FROM wine A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE B.Color = "Red" AND Year = ( SELECT A.Year FROM wine A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE B.Color = "White" GROUP BY A.Year ORDER BY SUM ( A.Cases ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) )

question: 白葡萄酒产量最高的年份是哪一年，比同年红葡萄酒的产量高多少？
sql: SELECT y.Year, y.White - y.Red AS Diff FROM (SELECT w.Year, SUM(CASE WHEN g.Color = 'White' THEN w.Cases ELSE 0 END) AS White, SUM(CASE WHEN g.Color = 'Red' THEN w.Cases ELSE 0 END) AS Red FROM wine AS w JOIN grapes AS g ON w.Grape = g.Grape GROUP BY w.Year) AS y WHERE y.White > y.Red ORDER BY y.White - y.Red DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT Year , cases_white - cases_red AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.Year , SUM ( A.Cases ) AS cases_white FROM wine A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE B.Color = "White" GROUP BY A.Year ORDER BY SUM ( A.Cases ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( A.Cases ) AS cases_red FROM wine A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE B.Color = "Red" AND Year = ( SELECT A.Year FROM wine A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE B.Color = "White" GROUP BY A.Year ORDER BY SUM ( A.Cases ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) )

question: 假如贝灵哲酒厂的全部酒产量翻倍，哪年白葡萄酒的产量最高，比当年红葡萄酒的产量高多少？

gold: SELECT Year , cases_white - cases_red AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.Year , SUM ( A.Cases ) AS cases_white FROM ( SELECT Grape , Year , 2 * Cases AS Cases FROM wine WHERE Winery = "Beringer" UNION ALL SELECT Grape , Year , Cases AS Cases FROM wine WHERE Winery != "Beringer" ) A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE B.Color = "White" GROUP BY A.Year ORDER BY SUM ( A.Cases ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( A.Cases ) AS cases_red FROM ( SELECT Grape , Year , 2 * Cases AS Cases FROM wine WHERE Winery = "Beringer" UNION ALL SELECT Grape , Year , Cases AS Cases FROM wine WHERE Winery != "Beringer" ) A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE B.Color = "Red" AND Year = ( SELECT A.Year FROM ( SELECT Grape , Year , 2 * Cases AS Cases FROM wine WHERE Winery = "Beringer" UNION ALL SELECT Grape , Year , Cases AS Cases FROM wine WHERE Winery != "Beringer" ) A JOIN grapes B ON A.Grape = B.Grape WHERE B.Color = "White" GROUP BY A.Year ORDER BY SUM ( A.Cases ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) )

gold: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE ( SELECT Song_release_year FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = "Love" ) - ( strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - Age ) > 2 * ( SELECT Age - ( strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - Song_release_year ) FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = "Love" )

question: If "Love" was released in 2010, at the time of the release of the song "Love," what are the names of singers who were more than twice as old as the singer of the song?
sql: SELECT s2.Name FROM singer AS s1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic1 ON s1.Singer_ID = sic1.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS c ON sic1.concert_ID = c.concert_ID JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic2 ON c.concert_ID = sic2.concert_ID JOIN singer AS s2 ON sic2.Singer_ID = s2.Singer_ID WHERE s1.Song_Name = 'Love' AND s1.Song_release_year = '2010' AND s2.Age > 2 * s1.Age LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE 2010 - ( strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - Age ) > 2 * ( SELECT Age - ( strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - 2010 ) FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = "Love" )

question: Assuming "Love" was released in 2010, which singers, at that time, had an age that was more than twice the age of the singer who performed the song? List their names.
sql: SELECT s1.Name FROM singer AS s1 JOIN singer AS s2 ON s2.Song_Name = 'Love' AND s2.Song_release_year = '2010' WHERE s1.Age > 2 * s2.Age LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE 2010 - ( strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - Age ) > 2 * ( SELECT Age - ( strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - 2010 ) FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = "Love" )

question: Which continent is the country with the highest GNP per capita located in?
sql: SELECT Continent FROM country ORDER BY GNP / Population DESC LIMIT 1

question: In which continent can we find the country with the highest GNP per capita?

question: If the gross national product of the country where Korla City is located is 1982268.0, which continent is the country with the highest GNP per capita located in?
sql: SELECT c.Continent FROM city AS ci JOIN country AS c ON ci.CountryCode = c.Code WHERE ci.Name = 'Korla' AND c.GNP = 1982268.0 ORDER BY c.GNP / c.Population DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT Continent FROM (SELECT "1982268.0" AS GNP, Population, Continent FROM country WHERE name = (SELECT A.name FROM country A JOIN city B ON A.Code = B.CountryCode WHERE B.name = "Korla" ) UNION ALL SELECT GNP, Population, Continent FROM country WHERE name != (SELECT A.name FROM country A JOIN city B ON A.Code = B.CountryCode WHERE B.name = "Korla" ) ) ORDER BY 1.0 * GNP / Population DESC LIMIT 1

question: Among the countries that became independent after 1979, which country has the highest growth rate of GNP?
sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 ORDER BY 1.0 * ( GNP - GNPOld ) / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which country, among those that gained independence after 1979, has the highest gross national product growth rate?
sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 ORDER BY 1.0 * ( GNP - GNPOld ) / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1

question: Among the countries that became independent after 1979, which country has the highest growth rate in GNP if all countries in Oceania have an increase in curretn GNP of 1,000,000?
sql: SELECT c.Name FROM country AS c WHERE c.IndepYear > 1979 AND c.Continent = 'Oceania' ORDER BY (c.GNP + 1000000.0 - c.GNPOld) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Assuming all countries in Oceania have an increase of 1,000,000 in their current GNP, which country among those that gained independence after 1979 has the highest gross national product growth rate?

question: Which country where the majority of people speak English has the highest population density, how many times larger than the country with the lowest population density?
sql: SELECT CAST(MAX(density) AS REAL) / MIN(density) AS ratio FROM (SELECT c.Code, c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea AS density FROM country AS c JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T') AS t LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT Name , ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) / ( SELECT MIN ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) FROM country WHERE 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea > 0 ) AS times FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT * , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "English" ) ORDER BY 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

question: Among the countries in which English is the most spoken language, which country has the highest population density? What is the ratio between the highest and lowest population density?
sql: SELECT c.Name, c.Population / c.SurfaceArea AS density, (SELECT MAX(c2.Population / c2.SurfaceArea) FROM country AS c2 JOIN countrylanguage AS cl2 ON c2.Code = cl2.CountryCode WHERE cl2.Language = 'English' AND cl2.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl3.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage AS cl3 WHERE cl3.CountryCode = c2.Code AND cl3.Language = 'English')) / (SELECT MIN(c3.Population / c3.SurfaceArea) FROM country AS c3 JOIN countrylanguage AS cl3 ON c3.Code = cl3.CountryCode WHERE cl3.Language = 'English' AND cl3.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl4.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage AS cl4 WHERE cl4.CountryCode = c3.Code AND cl4.Language = 'English')) AS ratio FROM country AS c JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage AS cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = c.Code AND cl2.Language = 'English') ORDER BY c.Population / c.SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT Name , ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) / ( SELECT MIN ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) FROM country WHERE 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea > 0 ) AS times FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT * , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "English" ) ORDER BY 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

question: If no one in Ireland speaks English, which country where the majority of people speak English has the highest population density, how many times larger than the country with the lowest population density?
sql: SELECT CAST(MAX_density.CountryPopulation AS REAL) / MAX_density.CountryArea AS max_density, CAST(MIN_density.CountryPopulation AS REAL) / MIN_density.CountryArea AS min_density, (CAST(MAX_density.CountryPopulation AS REAL) / MAX_density.CountryArea) / (CAST(MIN_density.CountryPopulation AS REAL) / MIN_density.CountryArea) AS ratio FROM (SELECT c.Population AS CountryPopulation, c.SurfaceArea AS CountryArea FROM country AS c JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 50 AND c.Code <> (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name = 'Ireland') ORDER BY CAST(c.Population AS REAL) / c.SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1) AS MAX_density CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.Population AS CountryPopulation, c.SurfaceArea AS CountryArea FROM country AS c JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 50 AND c.Code <> (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name = 'Ireland') ORDER BY CAST(c.Population AS REAL) / c.SurfaceArea ASC LIMIT 1) AS MIN_density LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT Name , ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) / ( SELECT MIN ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) FROM country WHERE 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea > 0 ) AS times FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT * , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage A JOIN country B ON A.CountryCode = B.Code WHERE B.name != "Ireland" GROUP BY A.CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "English" ) ORDER BY 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

question: If English is not spoken in Ireland, which country among those in which English is the most spoken language has the highest population density? What is the ratio between the highest and lowest population density?
sql: SELECT (SELECT MAX(pop_density) FROM (SELECT c.Population / c.SurfaceArea AS pop_density FROM country AS c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'Yes') AND c.Code <> (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name = 'Ireland'))) / (SELECT MIN(pop_density) FROM (SELECT c.Population / c.SurfaceArea AS pop_density FROM country AS c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS cl WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'Yes') AND c.Code <> (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Name = 'Ireland'))) AS density_ratio LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT Name , ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) / ( SELECT MIN ( 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ) FROM country WHERE 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea > 0 ) AS times FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT * , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage A JOIN country B ON A.CountryCode = B.Code WHERE B.name != "Ireland" GROUP BY A.CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "English" ) ORDER BY 100.0 * Population / SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which continent has a per capita GNP growth rate at least two percentage points higher than Europe?
sql: SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE GNP > 0 AND GNPOld > 0 GROUP BY Continent HAVING (SUM(GNP - GNPOld) / SUM(GNPOld)) >= (SELECT (SUM(GNP - GNPOld) / SUM(GNPOld)) + 0.02 FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Europe') LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT Continent FROM country GROUP BY Continent HAVING 1.0 * ( SUM ( GNP ) / SUM ( Population ) - SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) / ( SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) >= ( SELECT 1.0 * ( SUM ( GNP ) / SUM ( Population ) - SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) / ( SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) FROM country WHERE Continent = "Europe" ) + 0.02

question: Name a continent whose per capita GNP growth rate exceeds Europe by at least two percentage points?
sql: SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE (GNP - COALESCE(GNPOld, 0)) / COALESCE(NULLIF(GNPOld, 0), 1) * 100 - (SELECT AVG((GNP - COALESCE(GNPOld, 0)) / COALESCE(NULLIF(GNPOld, 0), 1) * 100) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Europe') >= 2 GROUP BY Continent LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT Continent FROM country GROUP BY Continent HAVING 1.0 * ( SUM ( GNP ) / SUM ( Population ) - SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) / ( SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) >= ( SELECT 1.0 * ( SUM ( GNP ) / SUM ( Population ) - SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) / ( SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) FROM country WHERE Continent = "Europe" ) + 0.02

question: If the GNP of the top three countries with the longest life expectancy decreases by 2%, which continent has a per capita GNP growth rate at least two points higher than Europe?
sql: SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE Code IN (SELECT Code FROM country ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3) AND GNP * 0.98 / Population >= (SELECT (AVG(GNP * 0.98) / AVG(Population)) * 1.02 FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Europe') GROUP BY Continent HAVING (SUM(GNP * 0.98) / SUM(Population)) >= (SELECT (AVG(GNP * 0.98) / AVG(Population)) * 1.02 FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Europe') LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT Continent FROM ( SELECT name , Continent , GNP * ( 1 - 0.02 ) AS GNP , Population , GNPOld FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT Code FROM country ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3 ) UNION ALL SELECT name , Continent , GNP , Population , GNPOld FROM country WHERE Code NOT IN ( SELECT Code FROM country ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3 ) ) GROUP BY Continent HAVING 1.0 * ( SUM ( GNP ) / SUM ( Population ) - SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) / ( SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) >= ( SELECT 1.0 * ( SUM ( GNP ) / SUM ( Population ) - SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) / ( SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) FROM country WHERE Continent = "Europe" ) + 0.02

question: Assuming a 2% decrease in the GNP of the top three countries with the highest life expectancy, which continent has a per capita GNP growth rate that exceeds Europe by at least two points?
sql: SELECT continent FROM (SELECT c.Continent, SUM(c.GNP * 0.98) / SUM(c.Population) AS new_per_capita_gnp, (SELECT SUM(c2.GNP * 0.98) / SUM(c2.Population) FROM country AS c2 WHERE c2.Continent = 'Europe') AS europe_per_capita_gnp FROM country AS c WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM country ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3) GROUP BY c.Continent) AS t WHERE new_per_capita_gnp > europe_per_capita_gnp + 2 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT Continent FROM ( SELECT name , Continent , GNP * ( 1 - 0.02 ) AS GNP , Population , GNPOld FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT Code FROM country ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3 ) UNION ALL SELECT name , Continent , GNP , Population , GNPOld FROM country WHERE Code NOT IN ( SELECT Code FROM country ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3 ) ) GROUP BY Continent HAVING 1.0 * ( SUM ( GNP ) / SUM ( Population ) - SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) / ( SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) >= ( SELECT 1.0 * ( SUM ( GNP ) / SUM ( Population ) - SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) / ( SUM ( GNPOld ) / SUM ( Population ) ) FROM country WHERE Continent = "Europe" ) + 0.02

question: List name, the past and current gross national product of each country in Asia, and estimate the future gross national product if the growth rate remains unchanged.

gold: SELECT name , GNPOld , GNP , GNP + ( GNP - GNPOld ) AS GNPFuture FROM country WHERE Continent = "Asia"

question: For each country in Asia, provide a list of their name, the past and current GNP, and estimate their future Gross National Product assuming a constant growth rate.
sql: SELECT c.Name, c.GNPOld AS past_GNP, c.GNP AS current_GNP, CASE WHEN NOT c.GNPOld IS NULL AND c.GNPOld > 0 THEN c.GNP + (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) ELSE NULL END AS estimated_future_GNP FROM country AS c WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT name , GNPOld , GNP , GNP + ( GNP - GNPOld ) AS GNPFuture FROM country WHERE Continent = "Asia"

question: If the current gross national product of a country with Chinese as its main language is 1000000.0, list name, the past and current gross national product of each country in Asia, and estimate the future gross national product if the growth rate remains unchanged.
sql: SELECT c.Name, c.GNPOld, c.GNP, c.GNP + (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) AS FutureGNP FROM country AS c INNER JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia' AND cl.Language = 'Chinese' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T' AND c.GNP = 1000000.0 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT name , GNPOld , GNP , GNP + ( GNP - GNPOld ) AS GNPFuture FROM ( SELECT name , GNPOld , 1000000.0 AS GNP , Continent FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT CountryCode , Language , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "Chinese" ) UNION ALL SELECT name , GNPOld , GNP , Continent FROM country WHERE Code NOT IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT CountryCode , Language , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "Chinese" ) ) WHERE Continent = "Asia"

question: Assuming that the country with Chinese as its primary language has a current GNP of 1000000.0, provide a list of their name, the past and current GNP for each Asian country, and estimate their future Gross National Product assuming a constant growth rate.
sql: SELECT c.Name, c.GNPOld AS Past_GNP, c.GNP AS Current_GNP, CASE WHEN NOT c.GNPOld IS NULL AND c.GNPOld <> 0 THEN c.GNP * (c.GNP / c.GNPOld) ELSE NULL END AS Future_GNP FROM country AS c JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Language = 'Chinese' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T' AND c.Continent = 'Asia' AND c.GNP = 1000000.0 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT name , GNPOld , GNP , GNP + ( GNP - GNPOld ) AS GNPFuture FROM ( SELECT name , GNPOld , 1000000.0 AS GNP , Continent FROM country WHERE Code IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT CountryCode , Language , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "Chinese" ) UNION ALL SELECT name , GNPOld , GNP , Continent FROM country WHERE Code NOT IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM ( SELECT CountryCode , Language , MAX ( Percentage ) FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode ) WHERE Language = "Chinese" ) ) WHERE Continent = "Asia"

question: How many bike stations are there in total in the City of the Golden Gate, and how many less than in the City of the Golden Gate in Palo Alto?

question: How many bike stations does the city of the Golden Gate have in total,  and how many less than in the City of the Golden Gate in Palo Alto if Palo Alto has 10 more bike stations than twice its original number of bike stations?

question: If the number of docks at each station built on August 20, 2013 is twice more than the number of docks at the "Grant Avenue at Columbus Avenue" station by five, how many available docks are there in total in the stations built on August 20, 2013 at the moment of 12:46:02 on June 2nd, 2015, and what about the unavailable docks?

question: Considering the stations constructed on 20th August 2013, which each have two times more the number of docks than "Grant Avenue at Columbus Avenue" station plus five, how many available and unavailable docks are there at 12:46:02 PM in 2015 on 2nd of June?

question: The cost of Apple products is 40% of the selling price, Gucci products is 20% of the selling price, and other products is 50% of the selling price. Please list each product's ID, name, sales volume, sales revenue, and total gross profit.
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.order_quantity) AS sales_volume, SUM(oi.order_quantity * p.product_price) AS sales_revenue, SUM(oi.order_quantity * p.product_price * (CASE WHEN p.product_name LIKE '%Apple%' THEN 0.6 WHEN p.product_name LIKE '%Gucci%' THEN 0.8 ELSE 0.5 END)) AS total_gross_profit FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( A.order_quantity ) AS quantity , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) AS revenue , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) * ( 1.0 - 40.0 / 100 ) AS profit FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id WHERE B.product_name = "Apple" GROUP BY B.product_id UNION SELECT B.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( A.order_quantity ) AS quantity , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) AS revenue , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) * ( 1.0 - 20.0 / 100 ) AS profit FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id WHERE B.product_name = "gucci" GROUP BY B.product_id UNION SELECT B.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( A.order_quantity ) AS quantity , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) AS revenue , SUM ( A.order_quantity * B.product_price ) * ( 1.0 - 50.0 / 100 ) AS profit FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id WHERE B.product_name != "Apple" AND B.product_name != "gucci" GROUP BY B.product_id UNION SELECT B.product_id , B.product_name , 0 , 0 , 0 FROM ( SELECT product_id FROM Products A EXCEPT SELECT B.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id ) A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id

question: What are the names of users with multiple contact methods and the amount of their first order?

gold: SELECT customer_name , price FROM ( SELECT M.customer_id , N.customer_name , M.price , MIN ( M.order_date ) FROM ( SELECT B.customer_id , B.order_id , B.order_date , SUM ( A.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS price FROM Order_Items A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON C.product_id = A.product_id GROUP BY B.customer_id , B.order_id ) M JOIN Customers N ON M.customer_id = N.customer_id WHERE M.customer_id IN ( SELECT customer_id FROM Contacts GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT ( * ) > 1 ) GROUP BY M.customer_id )

question: What are the names of users who have had multiple different addresses, and which postcode have they used the longest?
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, a.zip_postcode FROM Customers AS c JOIN Customer_Address_History AS cah1 ON c.customer_id = cah1.customer_id JOIN Addresses AS a ON cah1.address_id = a.address_id WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Customer_Address_History GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT address_id) > 1) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, a.zip_postcode ORDER BY SUM(JULIANDAY(COALESCE(cah1.date_to, '9999-12-31')) - JULIANDAY(cah1.date_from)) DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT customer_name, zip_postcode FROM (SELECT C.customer_name, B.zip_postcode, MAX (julianday (A.date_to) - julianday (A.date_from)) FROM Customer_Address_History A JOIN Addresses B ON A.address_id = B.address_id JOIN Customers C ON C.customer_id = A.customer_id GROUP BY A.customer_id HAVING COUNT (*) > 1)

question: Users can earn 222 points for a single order with a total price of over 1000 and another 666 points for a total price of over 2000. Which user currently has the most total points? Give me their ID.
why: 执行失败：exec:other: misuse of aggregate function SUM()
sql:
SELECT customer_id
FROM (
    SELECT 
        co.customer_id,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN SUM(oi.order_quantity * p.product_price) > 2000 THEN 666
                WHEN SUM(oi.order_quantity * p.product_price) > 1000 THEN 222
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_points
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY co.customer_id, co.order_id
) AS order_points
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY SUM(total_points) DESC
LIMIT 1;
gold: SELECT customer_id FROM ( SELECT customer_id , COUNT ( * ) * ( 666 + 222 ) AS points FROM ( SELECT B.customer_id , B.order_id , B.order_date , SUM ( A.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS price FROM Order_Items A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON C.product_id = A.product_id GROUP BY B.customer_id , B.order_id ) WHERE price > 2000 GROUP BY customer_id UNION SELECT customer_id , COUNT ( * ) * 222 AS points FROM ( SELECT B.customer_id , B.order_id , B.order_date , SUM ( A.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS price FROM Order_Items A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON C.product_id = A.product_id GROUP BY B.customer_id , B.order_id ) WHERE price > 1000 AND price < 2000 GROUP BY customer_id ) GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

gold: SELECT customer_id FROM ( SELECT customer_id , COUNT ( * ) * ( 666 + 222 ) AS points FROM ( SELECT B.customer_id , B.order_id , B.order_date , SUM ( A.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS price FROM Order_Items A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON C.product_id = A.product_id GROUP BY B.customer_id , B.order_id ) WHERE price > 2000 GROUP BY customer_id UNION SELECT customer_id , COUNT ( * ) * 222 AS points FROM ( SELECT B.customer_id , B.order_id , B.order_date , SUM ( A.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS price FROM Order_Items A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON C.product_id = A.product_id GROUP BY B.customer_id , B.order_id ) WHERE price > 1000 AND price < 2000 GROUP BY customer_id ) GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

question: If clothing prices increase by 20%, how much higher is the average unit price of clothing compared to hardware?
sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(product_price * 1.2) FROM Products WHERE product_type_code = 'clothing') - (SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM Products WHERE product_type_code = 'hardware') AS price_difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT ( 1 + 20.0 / 100 ) * clothes_avg - hw_avg AS diff FROM ( SELECT AVG ( product_price ) AS hw_avg FROM Products WHERE product_type_code = "Hardware" ) JOIN ( SELECT AVG ( product_price ) AS clothes_avg FROM Products WHERE product_type_code = "Clothes" )

question: Calculate how much higher the difference in average price is between clothing and hardware if clothing prices increase by 20%?
sql: SELECT (AVG(CASE WHEN p.product_type_code = 'clothing' THEN p.product_price * 1.2 ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN p.product_type_code = 'hardware' THEN p.product_price ELSE NULL END)) AS price_diff FROM Products AS p WHERE p.product_type_code IN ('clothing', 'hardware') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT ( 1 + 20.0 / 100 ) * clothes_avg - hw_avg AS diff FROM ( SELECT AVG ( product_price ) AS hw_avg FROM Products WHERE product_type_code = "Hardware" ) JOIN ( SELECT AVG ( product_price ) AS clothes_avg FROM Products WHERE product_type_code = "Clothes" )

question: How many users have used an address in a state with a capital city of Frankfurt, and what is the proportion of females among them?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS user_count, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN co.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS female_proportion FROM Customers AS c JOIN Customer_Address_History AS cah ON c.customer_id = cah.customer_id JOIN Addresses AS a ON cah.address_id = a.address_id JOIN Contacts AS co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id WHERE a.state_province_county = 'Hesse' AND a.city = 'Frankfurt' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT n_total , 1.0 * n_female / n_total AS female_ratio FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( A.customer_id ) ) AS n_female FROM Customer_Address_History A JOIN Addresses B ON A.address_id = B.address_id JOIN Contacts C ON A.customer_id = C.customer_id WHERE B.state_province_county = "Kentucky" AND C.gender = "female" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( A.customer_id ) ) AS n_total FROM Customer_Address_History A JOIN Addresses B ON A.address_id = B.address_id WHERE B.state_province_county = "Kentucky" )

question: What is the total number of users in the state with Frankfurt as the capital city? What proportion of this total are females?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_users, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS female_proportion FROM Customers AS cu JOIN Customer_Address_History AS cah ON cu.customer_id = cah.customer_id JOIN Addresses AS a ON cah.address_id = a.address_id JOIN Contacts AS c ON cu.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.city = 'Frankfurt' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT n_total , 1.0 * n_female / n_total AS female_ratio FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( A.customer_id ) ) AS n_female FROM Customer_Address_History A JOIN Addresses B ON A.address_id = B.address_id JOIN Contacts C ON A.customer_id = C.customer_id WHERE B.state_province_county = "Kentucky" AND C.gender = "female" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( A.customer_id ) ) AS n_total FROM Customer_Address_History A JOIN Addresses B ON A.address_id = B.address_id WHERE B.state_province_county = "Kentucky" )

question: What are the ID, name, and sales volume of the product that has the highest sales volume, and how much higher is it compared to the product with the lowest sales volume?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.order_quantity) AS sales_volume, (SELECT SUM(oi2.order_quantity) FROM Order_Items AS oi2 WHERE oi2.product_id = p.product_id) - (SELECT MIN(total_sales) FROM (SELECT product_id, SUM(order_quantity) AS total_sales FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id) AS min_sales) AS diff_from_lowest FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_volume DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT t1.product_id , t1.product_name , MAX ( t1.quantity ) AS max_quantity , t2.diff FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( quantity ) - MIN ( quantity ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) ) t2

question: Find me the product ID and name with the highest volume of sales, and tell me its sales volumne, and how much higher this volume is than the product with the lowest sales volume?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS sales_volume, MAX(SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER))) OVER () - MIN(SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER))) OVER () AS volume_diff FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_volume DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT t1.product_id , t1.product_name , MAX ( t1.quantity ) AS max_quantity , t2.diff FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( quantity ) - MIN ( quantity ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) ) t2

question: What are the ID and name of product that has the highest sales volume? If its sales volume was increased by 500, what is its sales volume and how much higher is it compared to the product with the lowest sales volume?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.order_quantity) + 500 AS new_sales_volume, SUM(oi.order_quantity) + 500 - (SELECT MIN(total_qty) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi2.order_quantity) AS total_qty FROM Order_Items AS oi2 GROUP BY oi2.product_id)) AS diff_from_lowest FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.order_quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT t1.product_id , t1.product_name , MAX ( t1.quantity ) + 500 AS max_quantity , t2.diff + 500 FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( quantity ) - MIN ( quantity ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) ) t2

question: Find me the ID and name of the product with the highest sales volume. What would its sales volume be if it increased by 500, and how much higher would its sale volume be , relative to the product with lowest sale?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS sales_volume, SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) + 500 AS sales_volume_plus_500, (SELECT SUM(CAST(oi2.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) FROM Order_Items AS oi2 GROUP BY oi2.product_id ORDER BY SUM(CAST(oi2.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) - SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS diff_from_lowest FROM Products AS p JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT t1.product_id , t1.product_name , MAX ( t1.quantity ) + 500 AS max_quantity , t2.diff + 500 FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( quantity ) - MIN ( quantity ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.product_id , B.product_name , SUM ( order_quantity ) AS quantity FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id UNION SELECT product_id , product_name , 0 AS quantity FROM Products WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT A.product_id FROM Order_Items A JOIN Products B ON A.product_id = B.product_id GROUP BY A.product_id ) ) ) t2

question: A 5% service charge is required for credit card payments. List the name of each customer and how much each customer spent on each order along with the order id.
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, co.order_id, SUM(oi.order_quantity * p.product_price) * 1.05 AS total_spent FROM Customers AS c JOIN Customer_Orders AS co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.payment_method_code = 'CREDIT_CARD' GROUP BY c.customer_name, co.order_id LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.customer_name , B.order_id , ( C.order_quantity * D.product_price ) * ( 1 + 5.0 / 100 ) AS cost_plus_fee FROM Customers A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id JOIN Order_Items C ON B.order_id = C.order_id JOIN Products D ON C.product_id = D.product_id WHERE A.payment_method_code = "Credit Card" GROUP BY A.customer_name , B.order_id UNION SELECT A.customer_name , B.order_id , C.order_quantity * D.product_price AS cost_plus_fee FROM Customers A JOIN Customer_Orders B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id JOIN Order_Items C ON B.order_id = C.order_id JOIN Products D ON C.product_id = D.product_id WHERE A.payment_method_code != "Credit Card" GROUP BY A.customer_name , B.order_id

question: List the year in record and the annual sales revenue for each year.
sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', co.order_date) AS year, SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL) * p.product_price) AS annual_sales_revenue FROM Customer_Orders AS co JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', co.order_date) ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT strftime ( "%Y" , A.order_date ) AS year , SUM ( B.order_quantity * C.product_price ) AS annual_sales_revenue FROM Customer_Orders A JOIN Order_Items B ON A.order_id = B.order_id JOIN Products C ON B.product_id = C.product_id GROUP BY strftime ( "%Y" , A.order_date )

question: List the highest price, lowest price, and variance of Apple products.
sql: SELECT MAX(product_price) AS highest_price, MIN(product_price) AS lowest_price, AVG((product_price - (SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM Products WHERE product_name LIKE '%Apple%')) * (product_price - (SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM Products WHERE product_name LIKE '%Apple%'))) AS variance FROM Products WHERE product_name LIKE '%Apple%' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT max_price , min_price , variance FROM ( SELECT 1.0 * ( product_price - AVG ( product_price ) ) * ( product_price - AVG ( product_price ) ) / COUNT ( * ) AS variance FROM Products WHERE product_name = "Apple" ) JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( product_price ) AS max_price , MIN ( product_price ) AS min_price FROM Products WHERE product_name = "Apple" )

question: Considering only Apple products tell me the highest and lowest prices and also the variance across the Apple range.
sql: SELECT MAX(product_price) AS highest_price, MIN(product_price) AS lowest_price, (MAX(product_price) - MIN(product_price)) / 2 AS variance FROM Products WHERE product_name LIKE '%Apple%' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT max_price , min_price , variance FROM ( SELECT 1.0 * ( product_price - AVG ( product_price ) ) * ( product_price - AVG ( product_price ) ) / COUNT ( * ) AS variance FROM Products WHERE product_name = "Apple" ) JOIN ( SELECT MAX ( product_price ) AS max_price , MIN ( product_price ) AS min_price FROM Products WHERE product_name = "Apple" )

question: List the IDs of customers and their ages when they signed up for the driving school.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, CAST((JULIANDAY(c.date_became_customer) - JULIANDAY(c.date_of_birth)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age_when_signed_up FROM Customers AS c LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT customer_id , strftime ( "%Y" , date_became_customer ) - strftime ( "%Y" , date_of_birth ) - ( strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_became_customer ) < strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_of_birth ) ) AS age FROM Customers

question: What percentage of customers with outstanding amounts larger than 2000 are good customers?

gold: SELECT 100.0 * good / n AS percent FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS good FROM Customers WHERE amount_outstanding > 2000 AND customer_status_code = "Good Customer" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n FROM Customers WHERE amount_outstanding > 2000 )

question: List the ID and number of lessons scheduled for staffs who were older than 20 when they joined the driving school.
sql: SELECT s.staff_id, COUNT(l.lesson_id) AS number_of_lessons FROM Staff AS s JOIN Lessons AS l ON s.staff_id = l.staff_id WHERE (STRFTIME('%Y', s.date_joined_staff) - STRFTIME('%Y', s.date_of_birth)) > 20 OR ((STRFTIME('%Y', s.date_joined_staff) - STRFTIME('%Y', s.date_of_birth)) = 20 AND STRFTIME('%m-%d', s.date_joined_staff) >= STRFTIME('%m-%d', s.date_of_birth)) GROUP BY s.staff_id LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.staff_id, COUNT (*) AS n_lesson FROM Staff A JOIN Lessons B ON A.staff_id = B.staff_id WHERE strftime ("%Y", A.date_joined_staff) - strftime ("%Y", A.date_of_birth) - (strftime ("%m-%d", A.date_joined_staff) < strftime ("%m-%d", A.date_of_birth)) > 20 UNION ALL SELECT staff_id, 0 AS n_lesson FROM Staff WHERE strftime ("%Y", date_joined_staff) - strftime ("%Y", date_of_birth) - (strftime ("%m-%d", date_joined_staff) < strftime ("%m-%d", date_of_birth)) > 20 AND staff_id NOT IN (SELECT A.staff_id FROM Staff A JOIN Lessons B ON A.staff_id = B.staff_id)

question: If the staffs who resigned on March 8th, 2018 all joined on March 8th, 2016, list the IDs and number of lessons scheduled for staffs who were older than 20 when they joined.
sql: SELECT s.staff_id, COUNT(l.lesson_id) AS lesson_count FROM Staff AS s LEFT JOIN Lessons AS l ON s.staff_id = l.staff_id WHERE s.date_left_staff = '2018-03-08 00:00:00' AND s.date_joined_staff = '2016-03-08 00:00:00' AND (JULIANDAY(s.date_joined_staff) - JULIANDAY(s.date_of_birth)) / 365.25 > 20 GROUP BY s.staff_id LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.staff_id, COUNT (*) AS n_lesson FROM (SELECT staff_id, date_of_birth, "2016-03-08" AS date_joined_staff FROM Staff WHERE strftime ("%Y-%m-%d", date_left_staff) = "2018-03-08" UNION ALL SELECT staff_id, date_of_birth, date_joined_staff FROM Staff WHERE strftime ("%Y-%m-%d", date_left_staff) != "2018-03-08" ) A JOIN Lessons B ON A.staff_id = B.staff_id WHERE strftime ("%Y", A.date_joined_staff) - strftime ("%Y", A.date_of_birth) - (strftime ("%m-%d", A.date_joined_staff) < strftime ("%m-%d", A.date_of_birth)) > 20 UNION ALL SELECT staff_id, 0 AS n_lesson FROM (SELECT staff_id, date_of_birth, "2016-03-08" AS date_joined_staff FROM Staff WHERE strftime ("%Y-%m-%d", date_left_staff) = "2018-03-08" UNION ALL SELECT staff_id, date_of_birth, date_joined_staff FROM Staff WHERE strftime ("%Y-%m-%d", date_left_staff) != "2018-03-08" ) WHERE strftime ("%Y", date_joined_staff) - strftime ("%Y", date_of_birth) - (strftime ("%m-%d", date_joined_staff) < strftime ("%m-%d", date_of_birth)) > 20 AND staff_id NOT IN (SELECT A.staff_id FROM Staff A JOIN Lessons B ON A.staff_id = B.staff_id)

question: Among the customers who have never attended a class, how much more bad customers than good customers?
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Lessons AS l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.lesson_id IS NULL AND c.customer_status_code = 'bad') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Lessons AS l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.lesson_id IS NULL AND c.customer_status_code = 'good') AS difference LIMIT 1000

question: How much is the average course fee for a staff who has no course schedule after March 5, 2018? What's his staff ID and how old is he this year?
sql: SELECT AVG(l.price) AS avg_course_fee, s.staff_id, CAST((STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', s.date_of_birth)) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Staff AS s LEFT JOIN Lessons AS l ON s.staff_id = l.staff_id AND l.lesson_date > '2018-03-05' WHERE l.lesson_id IS NULL GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.date_of_birth LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT A.staff_id , AVG ( A.price ) AS avg_price , strftime ( "%Y" , "now" ) - strftime ( "%Y" , B.date_of_birth ) - ( strftime ( "%m-%d" , "now" ) < strftime ( "%m-%d" , B.date_of_birth ) ) AS age FROM Lessons A JOIN Staff B ON A.staff_id = B.staff_id WHERE A.staff_id NOT IN ( SELECT staff_id FROM Lessons WHERE strftime ( "%Y-%m-%d" , lesson_date ) > "2018-03-05" ) GROUP BY A.staff_id

question: What's the ID of the coach who has the highest average course price and how much higher than that of the coach with the lowest average course price?
sql: SELECT (SELECT staff_id FROM Lessons GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY AVG(price) DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT staff_id FROM Lessons GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY AVG(price) ASC LIMIT 1) AS id_difference, (SELECT AVG(price) FROM Lessons GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY AVG(price) DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT AVG(price) FROM Lessons GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY AVG(price) ASC LIMIT 1) AS price_difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.staff_id , AVG ( A.price ) - ( SELECT AVG ( price ) FROM Lessons GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY AVG ( price ) ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS diff FROM Lessons A JOIN Staff B ON A.staff_id = B.staff_id GROUP BY A.staff_id ORDER BY AVG ( A.price ) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Tell me the ID of the coach who has the highest average course price and how much more does this cost than the average price from the coach with the lowest average price?

question: Calculate the difference in age between the oldest and youngest staff, if in 2020, Camylle Icie Weissnat was twice as old as someone born in 2009.
sql: SELECT MAX(JULIANDAY('2020-01-01') - JULIANDAY(date_of_birth)) / 365.25 - MIN(JULIANDAY('2020-01-01') - JULIANDAY(date_of_birth)) / 365.25 AS age_difference FROM Staff LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT MAX ( date_of_birth ) - MIN ( date_of_birth ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT 2020 - ( 2020 - 2009 ) * 2 AS date_of_birth FROM Staff WHERE first_name = "Camylle" AND middle_name = "Icie" AND last_name = "Weissnat" UNION ALL SELECT date_of_birth FROM Staff WHERE NOT ( first_name = "Camylle" AND middle_name = "Icie" AND last_name = "Weissnat" ) ) ORDER BY date_of_birth DESC

question: What is the total number of courses arranged for the oldest coach when leaving the driving school, and what percentage of them were canceled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_courses, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.lesson_status_code = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS cancellation_percentage FROM Lessons AS l JOIN Staff AS s ON l.staff_id = s.staff_id WHERE s.staff_id = (SELECT staff_id FROM Staff WHERE NOT date_left_staff IS NULL ORDER BY date_of_birth ASC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT total, 1.0 * n_cancel / total AS ratio FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS total FROM Lessons WHERE staff_id = ( SELECT staff_id FROM Staff ORDER BY strftime ( "%Y" , date_left_staff ) - strftime ( "%Y" , date_of_birth ) - ( strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_left_staff ) < strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_of_birth ) ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS n_cancel FROM Lessons WHERE staff_id = ( SELECT staff_id FROM Staff ORDER BY strftime ( "%Y" , date_left_staff ) - strftime ( "%Y" , date_of_birth ) - ( strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_left_staff ) < strftime ( "%m-%d" , date_of_birth ) ) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND lesson_status_code = "Cancelled" )

question: What's the ID of the customer who paid the most, and how much more than the customer who paid the least?
sql: SELECT (SELECT customer_id FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(amount_payment) DESC LIMIT 1) AS max_customer_id, (SELECT SUM(amount_payment) FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(amount_payment) DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT SUM(amount_payment) FROM Customer_Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(amount_payment) ASC LIMIT 1) AS amount_difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.customer_id , MAX ( A.amount_payment ) - ( SELECT MIN ( amount_payment ) FROM Customer_Payments ) AS payment_diff FROM Customer_Payments A JOIN Customers B ON A.customer_id = B.customer_id

question: Tell me the ID of the customer who paid the highest fee and how much more was this than the customer paying the lowest fee?

question: How old is Janessa Amara Sawayn five years after she left office, and how many years younger than Camylle Icie Weissnat?

question: What is the average lap time over the three sessions for the top ranked driver in the 2009 Australian Grand Prix qualifying?

question: How many races were held in 2009 and 2010 respectively? What is the difference between them?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS races_2009, SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS races_2010, SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM races LIMIT 1000

question: What are the first name and last name of the fastest and slowest driver in the first round of the 2006 British Grand Prix qualifying race? What is the difference between their lap time?
sql: SELECT d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.forename, d2.surname, (lt_fastest.milliseconds - lt_slowest.milliseconds) AS time_difference FROM qualifying AS q JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers AS d1 ON q.driverId = d1.driverId JOIN lapTimes AS lt_fastest ON q.raceId = lt_fastest.raceId AND q.driverId = lt_fastest.driverId JOIN drivers AS d2 ON (SELECT driverId FROM lapTimes WHERE raceId = r.raceId ORDER BY milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1) = d2.driverId JOIN lapTimes AS lt_slowest ON lt_slowest.raceId = r.raceId AND lt_slowest.driverId = d2.driverId WHERE r.year = 2006 AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix' AND r.round = 1 ORDER BY lt_fastest.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT forename_slowest , surname_slowest , forename_fastest , surname_fastest , time ( ( strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || slowest_q1 ) - strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || fastest_q1 ) ) , "unixepoch" ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT MAX ( A.q1 ) AS slowest_q1 , D.forename AS forename_slowest , D.surname AS surname_slowest FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId JOIN drivers D ON A.driverId = D.driverId WHERE B.name = "British Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2006" ) JOIN ( SELECT MIN ( A.q1 ) AS fastest_q1 , D.forename AS forename_fastest , D.surname AS surname_fastest FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId JOIN drivers D ON A.driverId = D.driverId WHERE B.name = "British Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2006" AND A.q1 != "" )

question: For the British Grand Prix in 2006, which racer was the fastest and which racer was the slowest? Provide their first name, last name, and the difference in lap time between them?
sql: SELECT d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.forename, d2.surname, (SELECT MAX(l.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes AS l JOIN races AS r ON l.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2006 AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix') - (SELECT MIN(l.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes AS l JOIN races AS r ON l.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2006 AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix') AS time_difference FROM lapTimes AS l1 JOIN drivers AS d1 ON l1.driverId = d1.driverId JOIN races AS r1 ON l1.raceId = r1.raceId JOIN lapTimes AS l2 ON TRUE JOIN drivers AS d2 ON l2.driverId = d2.driverId JOIN races AS r2 ON l2.raceId = r2.raceId WHERE r1.year = 2006 AND r1.name = 'British Grand Prix' AND l1.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(l.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes AS l JOIN races AS r ON l.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2006 AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix') AND r2.year = 2006 AND r2.name = 'British Grand Prix' AND l2.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(l.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes AS l JOIN races AS r ON l.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year = 2006 AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix') LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT forename_slowest , surname_slowest , forename_fastest , surname_fastest , time ( ( strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || slowest_q1 ) - strftime ( "%s" , "00:0" || fastest_q1 ) ) , "unixepoch" ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT MAX ( A.q1 ) AS slowest_q1 , D.forename AS forename_slowest , D.surname AS surname_slowest FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId JOIN drivers D ON A.driverId = D.driverId WHERE B.name = "British Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2006" ) JOIN ( SELECT MIN ( A.q1 ) AS fastest_q1 , D.forename AS forename_fastest , D.surname AS surname_fastest FROM qualifying A JOIN races B ON A.raceId = B.raceId JOIN drivers D ON A.driverId = D.driverId WHERE B.name = "British Grand Prix" AND B.year = "2006" AND A.q1 != "" )

gold: SELECT num_matches , num_no1 , 1.0 * num_no1 / num_matches AS possibility FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS num_matches FROM results A JOIN drivers B ON A.driverId = B.driverId WHERE B.surname = "Albers" AND B.forename = "Christijan" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS num_no1 FROM results A JOIN drivers B ON A.driverId = B.driverId WHERE B.surname = "Hamilton" AND B.forename = "Lewis" AND A.rank = "1" )

question: Count the number of races Lewis Hamilton has participated in and then the amount he has ranked first place. Therefore, what is his probability of winning first?

question: How many times is the number of circuits in the United States greater than that in the country with the largest land area in the world?

question: What is the ratio between the number of circuits in the United States to the number of circuits in the largest country as measured by land area?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / MAX(SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Canada' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'China' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'France' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Italy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Spain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Japan' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Brazil' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Australia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Monaco' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Austria' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Belgium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Hungary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Netherlands' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Singapore' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'South Korea' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Russia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Turkey' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Abu Dhabi' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Bahrain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Saudi Arabia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'Mexico' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) FROM circuits LIMIT 1000

question: Assuming there were 2 circuits in USA, how many times is the number of circuits in the United States greater than that in the country with the largest land area in the world?

question: Among the drivers who have the same nationality as the famous football player Cristiano Ronaldo, how many times is the number of players that participated in the 2006 United States Grand Prix greater than that of players who did not?
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results AS r JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE d.nationality = 'Portuguese' AND ra.year = 2006 AND ra.name = 'United States Grand Prix') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results AS r JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE d.nationality = 'Portuguese' AND NOT (ra.year = 2006 AND ra.name = 'United States Grand Prix')) AS difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * n_p / n_all FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT A.driverId ) AS n_p FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId JOIN races C ON B.raceId = C.raceID WHERE A.nationality = "Portuguese" AND C.name = "United States Grand Prix" AND C.year = "2006" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT A.driverId ) AS n_all FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId JOIN races C ON B.raceId = C.raceID WHERE A.nationality = "Portuguese" )

question: Among those professional drivers who share a nationality with Cristiano Ronaldo, what is the ratio between participating drivers to non-participating drivers for the 2006 Grand Prix in the United States?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT r.driverId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN r.driverId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM drivers AS d LEFT JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId AND r.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2006 AND name LIKE '%United States Grand Prix%') WHERE d.nationality = 'Portuguese' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * n_p / n_all FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT A.driverId ) AS n_p FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId JOIN races C ON B.raceId = C.raceID WHERE A.nationality = "Portuguese" AND C.name = "United States Grand Prix" AND C.year = "2006" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT A.driverId ) AS n_all FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId JOIN races C ON B.raceId = C.raceID WHERE A.nationality = "Portuguese" )

question: During George W. Bush's presidency, how many races did the United States host? How many times as many races as those held in the United Kingdom?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS us_races, SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'UK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uk_races, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'UK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE A.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND country = "UK" ) AS ratio FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE A.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND country = "USA"

question: What is the total count of races hosted in the U.S.A. during George W. Bush's tenure as President and how many times was this count greater than the number of races held in the U.K.?
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'USA' AND r.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'UK') AS diff LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE A.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND country = "UK" ) AS ratio FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE A.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND country = "USA"

question: During George W. Bush's presidency, how many races did the United States host? How many times as many races as those held in the UK assuming that there were 10 races held in UK during that time?
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND c.country = 'USA') AS usa_races, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND c.country = 'UK') AS uk_races, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND c.country = 'UK') = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND c.country = 'USA') / 10.0 END AS ratio_to_uk_per_10 LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / 10 AS ratio FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE A.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND country = "USA"

question: If the U.K. hosted 10 races during George W. Bush's tenure then how many times more races did the U.S.A. host in the same time period?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'UK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / 10 AS ratio FROM races A JOIN circuits B ON A.circuitId = B.circuitId WHERE A.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2009 AND country = "USA"

question: Provide the ID, first name, and number of races for drivers who have competed in at least twice as many races as Allen Berg and have the same nationality as the famous singer Michael Jackson.
sql: SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, COUNT(r.resultId) AS race_count FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE d.nationality = (SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Michael' AND surname = 'Jackson') AND d.driverId <> (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Allen' AND surname = 'Berg') GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename HAVING COUNT(r.resultId) >= 2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results AS r2 JOIN drivers AS d2 ON r2.driverId = d2.driverId WHERE d2.forename = 'Allen' AND d2.surname = 'Berg') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.driverId , forename AS first_name , COUNT ( * ) AS n_races FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId GROUP BY A.driverId HAVING COUNT ( * ) >= 2 * ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId WHERE A.forename = "Allen" AND A.surname = "Berg" ) AND A.nationality = "American"

question: Of the drivers sharing a nationality with late singer Michael Jackson, find me the ID, first name and race count for only those two competed in at least twice as many races as Allen Berg.
sql: SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, COUNT(r.resultId) AS race_count FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'American' AND d.driverId IN (SELECT r2.driverId FROM results AS r2 GROUP BY r2.driverId HAVING COUNT(r2.resultId) >= 2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results AS r3 JOIN drivers AS d2 ON r3.driverId = d2.driverId WHERE d2.forename = 'Allen' AND d2.surname = 'Berg')) GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.driverId , forename AS first_name , COUNT ( * ) AS n_races FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId GROUP BY A.driverId HAVING COUNT ( * ) >= 2 * ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId WHERE A.forename = "Allen" AND A.surname = "Berg" ) AND A.nationality = "American"

question: Assuming that Allen Berg participated in 10 races, provide the ID, first name, and number of races for drivers who have competed in at least twice as many races as Allen Berg and have the same nationality as the famous singer Michael Joseph Jackson.
sql: SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, COUNT(r.resultId) AS race_count FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE d.nationality = (SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Michael' AND surname = 'Jackson' LIMIT 1) AND d.driverId IN (SELECT r2.driverId FROM results AS r2 JOIN drivers AS d2 ON r2.driverId = d2.driverId WHERE d2.forename = 'Allen' AND d2.surname = 'Berg' GROUP BY r2.driverId HAVING COUNT(*) = 10) GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename HAVING COUNT(r.resultId) >= 20 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.driverId , forename AS first_name , COUNT ( * ) AS n_races FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId GROUP BY A.driverId HAVING COUNT ( * ) >= 2 * 10 AND A.nationality = "American"

question: Return the ID, first name and race count only for drivers who competed in at least twice as many races at Allen Berg's 10 competitive races and only tell me about drivers with the same nationality as singer Michael Jackson.
sql: SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, COUNT(r.resultId) AS race_count FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'American' /* Michael Jackson was American */ AND d.driverId IN (SELECT r2.driverId FROM results AS r2 JOIN races AS ra2 ON r2.raceId = ra2.raceId JOIN circuits AS c2 ON ra2.circuitId = c2.circuitId WHERE c2.name = 'Long Beach Grand Prix' /* Allen Berg's 10 competitive races were at Long Beach */ AND ra2.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1987 /* Allen Berg raced in F1 1983–1987, 10 races total */ GROUP BY r2.driverId HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 * 10 /* at least twice as many as 10 races */) GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT A.driverId , forename AS first_name , COUNT ( * ) AS n_races FROM drivers A JOIN results B ON A.driverId = B.driverId GROUP BY A.driverId HAVING COUNT ( * ) >= 2 * 10 AND A.nationality = "American"

question: How many days did John Smith stay in hospital?
sql: SELECT SUM(JULIANDAY(StayEnd) - JULIANDAY(StayStart)) AS days_stayed FROM Stay JOIN Patient ON Stay.Patient = Patient.SSN WHERE Patient.Name = 'John Smith' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT CAST ( julianday ( A.StayEnd ) - julianday ( A.StayStart ) AS INTEGER ) AS days_diff FROM Stay A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "John Smith"

question: How long was John Smith admitted to the hospital?
sql: SELECT JULIANDAY(s.StayEnd) - JULIANDAY(s.StayStart) AS admission_days FROM Stay AS s JOIN Patient AS p ON s.Patient = p.SSN WHERE p.Name = 'John Smith' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT CAST ( julianday ( A.StayEnd ) - julianday ( A.StayStart ) AS INTEGER ) AS days_diff FROM Stay A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "John Smith"

question: If John Smith left the hospital on International Nurses Day, how many days did John Smith stay in the hospital?
sql: SELECT JULIANDAY(s.StayEnd) - JULIANDAY(s.StayStart) AS days_stayed FROM Patient AS p JOIN Stay AS s ON p.SSN = s.Patient WHERE p.Name = 'John Smith' AND STRFTIME('%m-%d', s.StayEnd) = '05-12' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT julianday ( strftime ( "%Y-" , A.StayEnd ) || "05-12" ) - julianday ( strftime ( "%Y-" , A.StayStart ) || strftime ( "%m-%d" , A.StayStart ) ) AS date_diff FROM Stay A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "John Smith"

question: If John Smith was discharged from the hospital on International Nurses Day, for how long was he admitted to the hospital?
sql: SELECT JULIANDAY(s.StayEnd) - JULIANDAY(s.StayStart) AS AdmissionDurationDays FROM Patient AS p JOIN Stay AS s ON p.SSN = s.Patient WHERE p.Name = 'John Smith' AND STRFTIME('%m-%d', s.StayEnd) = '05-12' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT julianday ( strftime ( "%Y-" , A.StayEnd ) || "05-12" ) - julianday ( strftime ( "%Y-" , A.StayStart ) || strftime ( "%m-%d" , A.StayStart ) ) AS date_diff FROM Stay A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "John Smith"

question: How many more patients have used Foo Labs branded drugs than those have used Baz Industries branded drugs?
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.SSN) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Prescribes AS pr ON p.SSN = pr.Patient JOIN Medication AS m ON pr.Medication = m.Code WHERE m.Brand = 'Foo Labs') - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.SSN) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Prescribes AS pr ON p.SSN = pr.Patient JOIN Medication AS m ON pr.Medication = m.Code WHERE m.Brand = 'Baz Industries') AS difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Patient ) ) - ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Patient ) ) FROM Medication A JOIN Prescribes B ON A.code = B.Medication WHERE A.Brand = "Baz Industries" ) AS diff FROM Medication A JOIN Prescribes B ON A.code = B.Medication WHERE A.Brand = "Foo Labs"

question: What is the difference in the number of patients who have used drugs branded by Foo Labs compared to those who have used drugs branded by Baz Industries?
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.SSN) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Prescribes AS pr ON p.SSN = pr.Patient JOIN Medication AS m ON pr.Medication = m.Code WHERE m.Brand = 'Foo Labs') - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.SSN) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Prescribes AS pr ON p.SSN = pr.Patient JOIN Medication AS m ON pr.Medication = m.Code WHERE m.Brand = 'Baz Industries') AS difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Patient ) ) - ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Patient ) ) FROM Medication A JOIN Prescribes B ON A.code = B.Medication WHERE A.Brand = "Baz Industries" ) AS diff FROM Medication A JOIN Prescribes B ON A.code = B.Medication WHERE A.Brand = "Foo Labs"

question: If there were 10 patients who used Foo Labs brand drugs, how many more patients have used Foo Labs branded drugs than those have used Baz Industries branded drugs?

gold: SELECT 10 - ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Patient ) ) FROM Medication A JOIN Prescribes B ON A.code = B.Medication WHERE A.Brand = "Baz Industries" ) AS diff

question: If 10 patients have used drugs branded by Foo Labs, how many additional patients have used Foo Labs branded drugs compared to the number of patients who have used drugs branded by Baz Industries?
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.SSN) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Prescribes AS pr ON p.SSN = pr.Patient JOIN Medication AS m ON pr.Medication = m.Code WHERE m.Brand = 'Foo Labs') - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.SSN) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Prescribes AS pr ON p.SSN = pr.Patient JOIN Medication AS m ON pr.Medication = m.Code WHERE m.Brand = 'Baz Industries') AS additional_patients LIMIT 1000

question: How many times is the number of appointments made by the physician with the highest number of appointments compared to the physician with the lowest number of appointments?

question: All drugs are 2 dollars per dose. How much did Dennis Doe spend on all drugs and treatment in total?
sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(2 * CAST(P.dose AS REAL)) FROM Prescribes AS P JOIN Patient AS Pat ON P.Patient = Pat.SSN WHERE Pat.Name = 'Dennis Doe') + (SELECT SUM(Pro.Cost) FROM Undergoes AS U JOIN Patient AS Pat ON U.Patient = Pat.SSN JOIN Procedures AS Pro ON U.Procedures = Pro.Code WHERE Pat.Name = 'Dennis Doe') AS TotalCost LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT med_cost + pro_cost AS total_cost FROM ( SELECT 2 * SUM ( A.dose ) AS med_cost FROM Prescribes A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "Dennis Doe" ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( COST ) AS pro_cost FROM Procedures A JOIN Undergoes B ON A.Code = B.Procedures JOIN Patient C ON B.Patient = C.SSN WHERE C.name = "Dennis Doe" )

question: If all drugs cost 2 dollars per dose, what is the total amount spent by Dennis Doe on drugs and treatment?
sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(2) FROM Prescribes AS p JOIN Patient AS pt ON p.Patient = pt.SSN WHERE pt.Name = 'Dennis Doe') + (SELECT SUM(pro.Cost) FROM Undergoes AS u JOIN Patient AS pt ON u.Patient = pt.SSN JOIN Procedures AS pro ON u.Procedures = pro.Code WHERE pt.Name = 'Dennis Doe') AS TotalAmount LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT med_cost + pro_cost AS total_cost FROM ( SELECT 2 * SUM ( A.dose ) AS med_cost FROM Prescribes A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "Dennis Doe" ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( COST ) AS pro_cost FROM Procedures A JOIN Undergoes B ON A.Code = B.Procedures JOIN Patient C ON B.Patient = C.SSN WHERE C.name = "Dennis Doe" )

question: All drugs are 2 dollars per dose. If Dennis Doe bought 10 more doses of Thesisin at 16:53 on April 30th, 2008, how much did Dennis Doe spend on all drugs and treatment in total?
sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(p.Dose * 2) FROM Prescribes AS p JOIN Patient AS pt ON p.Patient = pt.SSN WHERE pt.Name = 'Dennis Doe') + (SELECT SUM(pr.Cost) FROM Undergoes AS u JOIN Procedures AS pr ON u.Procedures = pr.Code JOIN Patient AS pt ON u.Patient = pt.SSN WHERE pt.Name = 'Dennis Doe') AS total_cost LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT med_cost + pro_cost + 10 * 2 AS total_cost FROM ( SELECT 2 * SUM ( A.dose ) AS med_cost FROM Prescribes A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "Dennis Doe" AND A.Date != "2008-04-30 16:53" ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( COST ) AS pro_cost FROM Procedures A JOIN Undergoes B ON A.Code = B.Procedures JOIN Patient C ON B.Patient = C.SSN WHERE C.name = "Dennis Doe" )

question: If all drugs cost 2 dollars per dose and Dennis Doe purchased 10 additional doses of Thesisin at 16:53 on April 30, 2008, what is the total amount spent by Dennis Doe on all drugs and treatment?
sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(2 * 10) FROM Prescribes AS p JOIN Medication AS m ON p.Medication = m.Code JOIN Patient AS pt ON p.Patient = pt.SSN WHERE pt.Name = 'Dennis Doe' AND m.Name = 'Thesisin' AND p.Date = '2008-04-30 16:53:00') + (SELECT SUM(pr.Cost) FROM Undergoes AS u JOIN Procedures AS pr ON u.Procedures = pr.Code JOIN Patient AS pt ON u.Patient = pt.SSN WHERE pt.Name = 'Dennis Doe') AS total_amount LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT med_cost + pro_cost + 10 * 2 AS total_cost FROM ( SELECT 2 * SUM ( A.dose ) AS med_cost FROM Prescribes A JOIN Patient B ON A.Patient = B.SSN WHERE B.name = "Dennis Doe" AND A.Date != "2008-04-30 16:53" ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( COST ) AS pro_cost FROM Procedures A JOIN Undergoes B ON A.Code = B.Procedures JOIN Patient C ON B.Patient = C.SSN WHERE C.name = "Dennis Doe" )
