question: What is the proportion of physicians who belong to both Surgery department and General Medicine department out of physicians who belong to Surgery department?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s2.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'General Medicine') THEN s1.Physician END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT s1.Physician) AS proportion FROM Affiliated_With AS s1 LEFT JOIN Affiliated_With AS s2 ON s1.Physician = s2.Physician WHERE s1.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'Surgery') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM Affiliated_With WHERE Department = ( SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = "Surgery" ) ) AS prop FROM ( select * from Affiliated_With as A join department as B on A.Department = B.DepartmentID WHERE B.Name = "Surgery" or B.Name = "General Medicine" GROUP BY Physician HAVING COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.Name ) ) = 2 )

question: What is the ratio of physicians who are members of both the Surgery department and the General Medicine department, compared to the total number of physicians in the Surgery department?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s1.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'Surgery') AND s2.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'General Medicine') THEN s1.Physician END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'Surgery') THEN s.Physician END) AS ratio FROM Affiliated_With AS s LEFT JOIN Affiliated_With AS s1 ON s.Physician = s1.Physician AND s1.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'Surgery') LEFT JOIN Affiliated_With AS s2 ON s.Physician = s2.Physician AND s2.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'General Medicine') WHERE s.Department = (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = 'Surgery') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM Affiliated_With WHERE Department = ( SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = "Surgery" ) ) AS prop FROM ( select * from Affiliated_With as A join department as B on A.Department = B.DepartmentID WHERE B.Name = "Surgery" or B.Name = "General Medicine" GROUP BY Physician HAVING COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.Name ) ) = 2 )

question: If Keith Dudermeister belongs to both the Surgery department and the General Medicine department, what is the proportion of physicians who belong to both the Surgery department and the General Medicine department among physicians who belong to the Surgery department?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN d2.Name = 'General Medicine' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS proportion FROM Affiliated_With AS a1 JOIN Department AS d1 ON a1.Department = d1.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN Affiliated_With AS a2 ON a1.Physician = a2.Physician LEFT JOIN Department AS d2 ON a2.Department = d2.DepartmentID WHERE d1.Name = 'Surgery' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * ( 1 + COUNT ( * ) ) / ( 1 + ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM Affiliated_With as A join Physician as B on A.Physician = B.EmployeeID WHERE B.Name != "Keith Dudermeister" and Department = ( SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = "Surgery" ) ) ) AS prop FROM ( select * from Affiliated_With as A join department as B on A.Department = B.DepartmentID join Physician as C on A.Physician = C.EmployeeID WHERE C.Name != "Keith Dudermeister" and ( B.Name = "Surgery" or B.Name = "General Medicine" ) GROUP BY Physician HAVING COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.Name ) ) = 2 )

question: If Keith Dudermeister is a member of both the Surgery and General Medicine departments, what is the proportion of physicians who belong to both departments out of the total number of physicians in the Surgery department?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN d1.Name = 'Surgery' AND d2.Name = 'General Medicine' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d1.Name = 'Surgery' THEN 1 END) AS proportion FROM Affiliated_With AS aw1 JOIN Department AS d1 ON aw1.Department = d1.DepartmentID JOIN Affiliated_With AS aw2 ON aw1.Physician = aw2.Physician JOIN Department AS d2 ON aw2.Department = d2.DepartmentID WHERE d1.Name = 'Surgery' AND d2.Name = 'General Medicine' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * ( 1 + COUNT ( * ) ) / ( 1 + ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM Affiliated_With as A join Physician as B on A.Physician = B.EmployeeID WHERE B.Name != "Keith Dudermeister" and Department = ( SELECT DepartmentID FROM Department WHERE Name = "Surgery" ) ) ) AS prop FROM ( select * from Affiliated_With as A join department as B on A.Department = B.DepartmentID join Physician as C on A.Physician = C.EmployeeID WHERE C.Name != "Keith Dudermeister" and ( B.Name = "Surgery" or B.Name = "General Medicine" ) GROUP BY Physician HAVING COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.Name ) ) = 2 )

gold: SELECT 1.0 * ( COUNT ( * ) + ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON C.Coach_ID = B.Coach_ID WHERE C.Coach_name = "Jameson Tomas" AND A.Player_name = "Fiona Shiells" ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON C.Coach_ID = B.Coach_ID WHERE C.Coach_name = "Jameson Tomas" ) AS prob FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON C.Coach_ID = B.Coach_ID WHERE C.Coach_name = "Jameson Tomas" AND A.Rank = "1st" AND A.Player_name != "Fiona Shiells"

question: Coaches earn $100 for every champion they guided, $60 for every runner-up and $20 for every third-place finisher. What's the name of the coach who gets the most bonuses and how much does they earn?

question: If a player has no coach then how likely is it that they will win the championship?

gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player WHERE Player_ID NOT IN ( SELECT A.Player_ID AS player_with_coach FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) ) AS ratio FROM player WHERE Player_ID NOT IN ( SELECT A.Player_ID AS player_with_coach FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) AND Rank = "1st"

question: How much more likely is the coached player to finish in the top two than the uncoached player?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT pc.Player_ID IS NULL AND m.Rank IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT pc.Player_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pc.Player_ID IS NULL AND m.Rank IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pc.Player_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN player_coach AS pc ON p.Player_ID = pc.Player_ID LEFT JOIN match_result AS m ON p.Player_ID = m.Rank LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) - ( SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player WHERE Player_ID NOT IN ( SELECT A.Player_ID AS player_with_coach FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) ) FROM player WHERE Player_ID NOT IN ( SELECT A.Player_ID AS player_with_coach FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) AND ( Rank = "1st" OR Rank = "2nd" ) ) AS diff FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID WHERE ( A.Rank = "1st" OR A.Rank = "2nd" )

question: What is the difference in likelihood of a coached player finishing in the top two versus an uncoached player?
sql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Player_ID IN (SELECT pc.Player_ID FROM player_coach AS pc) THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) - (COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT p.Player_ID IN (SELECT pc.Player_ID FROM player_coach AS pc) THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS likelihood_diff FROM player AS p WHERE p.Rank IN ('1', '2') LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) - ( SELECT 1.0 * COUNT ( * ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player WHERE Player_ID NOT IN ( SELECT A.Player_ID AS player_with_coach FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) ) FROM player WHERE Player_ID NOT IN ( SELECT A.Player_ID AS player_with_coach FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) AND ( Rank = "1st" OR Rank = "2nd" ) ) AS diff FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID WHERE ( A.Rank = "1st" OR A.Rank = "2nd" )

question: If Niki Ashton was an uncoached player, how much more likely is the coached player to finish in the top two than the uncoached player?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT p_coach.Player_ID IS NULL AND m.Rank <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT p_coach.Player_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p_coach.Player_ID IS NULL AND m.Rank <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p_coach.Player_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN player_coach AS p_coach ON p.Player_ID = p_coach.Player_ID LEFT JOIN match_result AS m ON p.Player_ID = m.Rank /* 注意：match_result.Rank 是主键，但此处逻辑上应关联 Player_ID；根据题干字段定义，match_result 表中无 Player_ID 字段，仅 Club_ID；因此需重新审视逻辑 */ LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT prob_1 - prob_2 AS diff FROM ( SELECT 1.0 * ( COUNT ( * ) - ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID WHERE ( A.Rank = "1st" OR A.Rank = "2nd" ) AND A.Player_name = "Niki Ashton" ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID WHERE A.Player_name != "Niki Ashton" ) AS prob_1 FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID WHERE ( A.Rank = "1st" OR A.Rank = "2nd" ) ) JOIN ( SELECT 1.0 * ( COUNT ( * ) + ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) From player WHERE ( Rank = "1st" OR Rank = "2nd" ) AND Player_name = "Niki Ashton" ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) + 1 FROM player WHERE Player_ID NOT IN ( SELECT A.Player_ID AS player_with_coach FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) AND Player_name != "Niki Ashton" ) AS prob_2 FROM player WHERE Player_ID NOT IN ( SELECT A.Player_ID AS player_with_coach FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) AND ( Rank = "1st" OR Rank = "2nd" ) AND Player_name != "Niki Ashton" )

question: How much likelier is it that a coached player ranks in the top two than a player without a coach if Niki Ashton has no coach?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Rank IN ('1', '2') AND NOT pc.Player_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN NOT pc.Player_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Rank IN ('1', '2') AND pc.Player_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN pc.Player_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN player_coach AS pc ON p.Player_ID = pc.Player_ID WHERE p.Player_name <> 'Niki Ashton' OR NOT pc.Player_ID IS NULL LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT prob_1 - prob_2 AS diff FROM ( SELECT 1.0 * ( COUNT ( * ) - ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID WHERE ( A.Rank = "1st" OR A.Rank = "2nd" ) AND A.Player_name = "Niki Ashton" ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID WHERE A.Player_name != "Niki Ashton" ) AS prob_1 FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID WHERE ( A.Rank = "1st" OR A.Rank = "2nd" ) ) JOIN ( SELECT 1.0 * ( COUNT ( * ) + ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) From player WHERE ( Rank = "1st" OR Rank = "2nd" ) AND Player_name = "Niki Ashton" ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) + 1 FROM player WHERE Player_ID NOT IN ( SELECT A.Player_ID AS player_with_coach FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) AND Player_name != "Niki Ashton" ) AS prob_2 FROM player WHERE Player_ID NOT IN ( SELECT A.Player_ID AS player_with_coach FROM player A JOIN player_coach B ON A.Player_ID = B.Player_ID JOIN coach C ON B.Coach_ID = C.Coach_ID ) AND ( Rank = "1st" OR Rank = "2nd" ) AND Player_name != "Niki Ashton" )

question: The passing rating consists of 5% curve, 5% free kick accuracy, 15% long passing, 20% crossing, 20% vision, and 35% short passing. List the name and current age of the top 10 players who have the highest passing rating.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, CAST((STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', p.birthday)) AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%m-%d', 'now') < STRFTIME('%m-%d', p.birthday) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age, ROUND(0.05 * pa.curve + 0.05 * pa.free_kick_accuracy + 0.15 * pa.long_passing + 0.20 * pa.crossing + 0.20 * pa.vision + 0.35 * pa.short_passing, 2) AS passing_rating FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE pa.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM Player_Attributes) ORDER BY passing_rating DESC LIMIT 10
gold: SELECT name , age FROM ( SELECT B.player_name AS name , MAX ( 0.05 * A.curve + 0.05 * A.free_kick_accuracy + 0.15 * A.long_passing + 0.2 * A.crossing + 0.2 * A.vision + 0.35 * A.short_passing ) AS passing_rating , DATE ( "now" ) - strftime ( "%Y-%m-%d" , B.birthday ) AS age FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ORDER BY passing_rating DESC LIMIT 10 )

question: Find me the name and age today of the top 10 players who have the current highest passing rating as measured by 5% curve, 5% free kick accuracy, 15% long passing, 20% crossing, 20% vision and 40% short passing.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, CAST((STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', p.birthday)) - (STRFTIME('%m-%d', 'now') < STRFTIME('%m-%d', p.birthday)) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE pa.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM Player_Attributes) ORDER BY (0.05 * pa.curve + 0.05 * pa.free_kick_accuracy + 0.15 * pa.long_passing + 0.20 * pa.crossing + 0.20 * pa.vision + 0.40 * pa.short_passing) DESC LIMIT 10
gold: SELECT name , age FROM ( SELECT B.player_name AS name , MAX ( 0.05 * A.curve + 0.05 * A.free_kick_accuracy + 0.15 * A.long_passing + 0.2 * A.crossing + 0.2 * A.vision + 0.35 * A.short_passing ) AS passing_rating , DATE ( "now" ) - strftime ( "%Y-%m-%d" , B.birthday ) AS age FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ORDER BY passing_rating DESC LIMIT 10 )

question: The passing rating consists of 5% curve, 5% free kick accuracy, 15% long passing, 20% crossing, 20% vision, and 35% short passing. Assuming ratings of vision attribute for all players are 80, list the name and current age of the top 10 players who have the highest passing rating.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, CAST((STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', p.birthday)) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE pa.vision = 80 ORDER BY (0.05 * pa.curve + 0.05 * pa.free_kick_accuracy + 0.15 * pa.long_passing + 0.20 * pa.crossing + 0.20 * pa.vision + 0.35 * pa.short_passing) DESC LIMIT 10
gold: SELECT name , age FROM ( SELECT B.player_name AS name , MAX ( 0.05 * A.curve + 0.05 * A.free_kick_accuracy + 0.15 * A.long_passing + 0.2 * A.crossing + 0.2 * 80 + 0.35 * A.short_passing ) AS passing_rating , DATE ( "now" ) - strftime ( "%Y-%m-%d" , B.birthday ) AS age FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ORDER BY passing_rating DESC LIMIT 10 )

question: What are the names and present day ages for the top ten players as measured by passing rating if all players have equivalent vision attribute of 80? Calculate passing rating according to sum of 35% short passing, 20% vision, 20% corssing, 15% long passing, 5% free kick accuracy and 5% curve.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, CAST((JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(p.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE pa.vision = 80 ORDER BY (0.35 * pa.short_passing + 0.20 * pa.vision + 0.20 * pa.crossing + 0.15 * pa.long_passing + 0.05 * pa.free_kick_accuracy + 0.05 * pa.curve) DESC LIMIT 10
gold: SELECT name , age FROM ( SELECT B.player_name AS name , MAX ( 0.05 * A.curve + 0.05 * A.free_kick_accuracy + 0.15 * A.long_passing + 0.2 * A.crossing + 0.2 * 80 + 0.35 * A.short_passing ) AS passing_rating , DATE ( "now" ) - strftime ( "%Y-%m-%d" , B.birthday ) AS age FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ORDER BY passing_rating DESC LIMIT 10 )

question: The pace rating consists of 45% acceleration rating and 55% sprint speed rating. List the names of the top three players in terms of pace, and list their height, weight and the body mass index.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, p.height, p.weight, ROUND(p.weight / POWER(p.height / 100.0, 2), 2) AS bmi FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id ORDER BY (0.45 * pa.acceleration + 0.55 * pa.sprint_speed) DESC LIMIT 3
gold: SELECT player_name , height , weight , BMI FROM ( SELECT B.player_name , MAX ( 0.45 * A.acceleration + 0.55 * A.sprint_speed ) AS pace_rating , B.height , B.weight , B.weight * 0.45 / ( ( 1.0 * B.height / 100 ) * ( 1.0 * B.height / 100 ) ) AS BMI FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ) ORDER BY pace_rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the name, height, weight and body mass index of the top three players in terms of pace as measured by summing 45% acceleration rating and 55% sprint speed rating.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, p.height, p.weight, ROUND(p.weight / POWER(p.height / 100.0, 2), 2) AS body_mass_index FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id ORDER BY (0.45 * pa.acceleration + 0.55 * pa.sprint_speed) DESC LIMIT 3
gold: SELECT player_name , height , weight , BMI FROM ( SELECT B.player_name , MAX ( 0.45 * A.acceleration + 0.55 * A.sprint_speed ) AS pace_rating , B.height , B.weight , B.weight * 0.45 / ( ( 1.0 * B.height / 100 ) * ( 1.0 * B.height / 100 ) ) AS BMI FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ) ORDER BY pace_rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: The pace rating consists of 45% acceleration rating and 55% sprint speed rating. Assuming rating of acceleration attribute for all players is 75, list the names of the top three players in terms of pace, and list their height, weight and the body mass index.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, p.height, p.weight, ROUND(p.weight / POWER(p.height / 100.0, 2), 2) AS bmi FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE pa.acceleration = 75 ORDER BY (0.45 * pa.acceleration + 0.55 * pa.sprint_speed) DESC LIMIT 3
gold: SELECT player_name , height , weight , BMI FROM ( SELECT B.player_name , MAX ( 0.45 * 75 + 0.55 * A.sprint_speed ) AS pace_rating , B.height , B.weight , B.weight * 0.45 / ( ( 1.0 * B.height / 100 ) * ( 1.0 * B.height / 100 ) ) AS BMI FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ) ORDER BY pace_rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: Give me the names, body mass index, height and weight of the top three players measured by pace (sum 45% acceleration rating and 55% sprint speed rating) when all players have acceleration attribute of 75.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, CAST(p.weight AS REAL) / (p.height / 100.0) / (p.height / 100.0) AS bmi, p.height, p.weight FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE pa.acceleration = 75 ORDER BY (0.45 * pa.acceleration + 0.55 * pa.sprint_speed) DESC LIMIT 3
gold: SELECT player_name , height , weight , BMI FROM ( SELECT B.player_name , MAX ( 0.45 * 75 + 0.55 * A.sprint_speed ) AS pace_rating , B.height , B.weight , B.weight * 0.45 / ( ( 1.0 * B.height / 100 ) * ( 1.0 * B.height / 100 ) ) AS BMI FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ) ORDER BY pace_rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: List names of the top three players with the largest difference between overall rating and potential ability, and list the differences.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, (pa.overall_rating - pa.potential) AS rating_difference FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE NOT pa.overall_rating IS NULL AND NOT pa.potential IS NULL ORDER BY rating_difference DESC LIMIT 3
gold: SELECT B.player_name , MAX ( ABS ( A.potential - A.overall_rating ) ) AS difference FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of the players with the largest discrepancy between overall rating and potential ability? Return only the top 3 and list the difference between rating and ability.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, (pa.overall_rating - pa.potential) AS rating_diff FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id ORDER BY rating_diff DESC LIMIT 3
gold: SELECT B.player_name , MAX ( ABS ( A.potential - A.overall_rating ) ) AS difference FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 3

question: Assuming players with an overall rating below 70 are increased by 5 in their overall rating, list names of the top three players with the largest difference between overall rating and potential ability.
sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating >= 70 ORDER BY (pa.overall_rating - pa.potential) DESC LIMIT 3
gold: SELECT player_name , MAX ( difference ) FROM ( SELECT B.player_name , ABS ( A.overall_rating - A.potential ) AS difference FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.overall_rating >= 70 UNION SELECT B.player_name , ABS ( A.overall_rating + 5 - A.potential ) AS difference FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.overall_rating < 70 ) GROUP BY player_name ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top three players with the largest absolute difference between potential ability and overall rating if all players with an overall rating of 70 get an increase in rating of 5.
sql: SELECT player_name FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating = 70 ORDER BY ABS((pa.potential) - (pa.overall_rating + 5)) DESC LIMIT 3
gold: SELECT player_name , MAX ( difference ) FROM ( SELECT B.player_name , ABS ( A.overall_rating - A.potential ) AS difference FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.overall_rating >= 70 UNION SELECT B.player_name , ABS ( A.overall_rating + 5 - A.potential ) AS difference FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.overall_rating < 70 ) GROUP BY player_name ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 3

question: Rating 80 to 89 points means very good. Among players that are very good at passing without conceding the ball, how many are left-footed and how many are right-footed, and what is the difference between them?
sql: SELECT preferred_foot, COUNT(*) AS count FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating BETWEEN 80 AND 89 AND preferred_foot IN ('left', 'right') GROUP BY preferred_foot ORDER BY preferred_foot LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT left_footed , right_footed , ABS ( left_footed - right_footed ) AS difference FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.player_name ) ) AS left_footed FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.dribbling BETWEEN 80 AND 89 AND A.preferred_foot = "left" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.player_name ) ) AS right_footed FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.dribbling BETWEEN 80 AND 89 AND A.preferred_foot = "right" )

question: What is the sum of players that are left-footed and right-footed (and the difference between the two sums) for players rated very good at passing without conceding the ball (rating 80 to 89 points is very good).
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS left_footed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Right' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS right_footed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Right' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating BETWEEN 80 AND 89 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT left_footed , right_footed , ABS ( left_footed - right_footed ) AS difference FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.player_name ) ) AS left_footed FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.dribbling BETWEEN 80 AND 89 AND A.preferred_foot = "left" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.player_name ) ) AS right_footed FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.dribbling BETWEEN 80 AND 89 AND A.preferred_foot = "right" )

question: What is the name of the goalkeeper with the highest ratingin terms of the ability of catching the ball clean and positioning correctly for saves?
sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE NOT pa.gk_diving IS NULL AND NOT pa.gk_positioning IS NULL ORDER BY (pa.gk_diving + pa.gk_positioning) DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT player_name FROM ( SELECT B.player_name , MAX ( A.positioning + A.gk_handling ) AS goalkeeper_rating FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ) ORDER BY goalkeeper_rating DESC LIMIT 1

question: Considering ability of catching the ball clean and correct positioning for saves, which goalkeeper has the highest rating? Give me his name.

gold: SELECT player_name FROM ( SELECT B.player_name , MAX ( A.positioning + A.gk_handling ) AS goalkeeper_rating FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id GROUP BY B.player_name ) ORDER BY goalkeeper_rating DESC LIMIT 1

question: For the player who gets tired during a game at the highest rate, what is his name and his total rating in terms of long shots and short power?
sql: SELECT p.player_name, pa.long_shots + pa.short_passing AS total_rating FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE pa.stamina = (SELECT MIN(stamina) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE NOT stamina IS NULL) LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT B.player_name , A.long_shots + A.shot_power AS total_rating FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE NOT ( A.stamina IS NULL ) ORDER BY A.stamina ASC LIMIT 1

question: Give me the name and total rating in long shots and short power of the player with the maximum rate of tiredness increase during a game?

gold: SELECT B.player_name , A.long_shots + A.shot_power AS total_rating FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE NOT ( A.stamina IS NULL ) ORDER BY A.stamina ASC LIMIT 1

question: For the player who gets tired during a game at the highest rate, what is his name and his total rating in terms of long shots and short power, if his long shots rating was assumed to be 90?

question: Find me the name of the player who tires the fastest during a game and then calculate their total rating with respect to long shots and short power if the long shots rating is now 90.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, pa.long_shots + pa.short_passing AS total_rating FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE pa.long_shots = 90 ORDER BY pa.stamina ASC LIMIT 1

question: The defensive rating is composed of ratings for pressure, aggression, and team width. Provide the short names of the teams with the highest and lowest defensive ratings.
sql: SELECT team_short_name FROM (SELECT t.team_short_name, (ta.defencePressure + ta.defenceAggression + ta.defenceTeamWidth) AS defensive_rating, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (ta.defencePressure + ta.defenceAggression + ta.defenceTeamWidth) DESC) AS rn_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (ta.defencePressure + ta.defenceAggression + ta.defenceTeamWidth) ASC) AS rn_asc FROM Team AS t JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON t.team_fifa_api_id = ta.team_fifa_api_id WHERE ta.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE team_fifa_api_id = ta.team_fifa_api_id)) AS ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1 OR rn_asc = 1 LIMIT 1000

question: The shooting rating is comprised of 6 attributes, including 45% finishing, 20% long shots, 5% penalties, 5% positioning, 20% shot power, and 5% volleys. What is the name and shooting rating of the top 1 player in terms of shooting rating?
sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(
        0.45 * pa.finishing +
        0.20 * pa.long_shots +
        0.05 * pa.penalties +
        0.05 * pa.positioning +
        0.20 * pa.shot_power +
        0.05 * pa.volleys
    ) AS shooting_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(date) 
    FROM Player_Attributes 
    WHERE player_api_id = p.player_api_id
)
ORDER BY shooting_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;
gold: SELECT B.player_name , 0.45 * A.finishing + 0.2 * A.long_shots + 0.05 * penalties + 0.05 * positioning + 0.2 * shot_power + 0.05 * volleys AS shooting_rating FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id ORDER BY shooting_rating DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the long passing ratings for the players with the best and worst awareness of the position of their teammates and opponents around them? What is the difference?
sql: SELECT (SELECT long_passing FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY vision DESC LIMIT 1) AS best_long_passing, (SELECT long_passing FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY vision ASC LIMIT 1) AS worst_long_passing, (SELECT long_passing FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY vision DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT long_passing FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY vision ASC LIMIT 1) AS difference LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT best_vision_long_passing , worst_vision_long_passing , ABS ( worst_vision_long_passing - best_vision_long_passing ) AS diff FROM ( SELECT A.long_passing AS best_vision_long_passing , MAX ( A.vision ) FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id ) JOIN ( SELECT A.long_passing AS worst_vision_long_passing , MIN ( A.vision ) FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id )

question: Among the players with medium attack rating, what is the ratio between the highest and lowest scores which measure the quality of physical strength?

question: Rating between 80 to 89 points means very good. Rating between 70 to 79 points means good. What is the proportion of players with very good accuracy to those with good accuracy when shooting from inside the penalty area?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pa.finishing BETWEEN 80 AND 89 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN pa.finishing BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion FROM Player_Attributes AS pa WHERE pa.finishing BETWEEN 70 AND 89 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * very_good / good AS proportion FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS very_good FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.penalties BETWEEN 80 AND 89 ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS good FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.penalties BETWEEN 70 AND 79 )

question: Calculate the proportion of players with very good accuracy (80 to 89 points) to players with good accuracy (70 to 79 points) when only shooting from inside the penalty area.
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pa.shot_power >= 80 AND pa.shot_power <= 89 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN pa.shot_power >= 70 AND pa.shot_power <= 79 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion FROM Player_Attributes AS pa LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * very_good / good AS proportion FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS very_good FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.penalties BETWEEN 80 AND 89 ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS good FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.penalties BETWEEN 70 AND 79 )

question: How many times does the tallest player weigh as much as the shortest player?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player AS p1 CROSS JOIN Player AS p2 WHERE p1.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) AND p2.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player) AND p1.weight = p2.weight LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * highest_weight / lowest_weight AS times FROM ( SELECT weight AS highest_weight , MAX ( height ) FROM Player ) JOIN ( SELECT weight AS lowest_weight , MIN ( height ) FROM Player )

question: How many more times is the weight of the tallest player to the weight of the shortest player as a proportion?
sql: SELECT CAST((SELECT weight FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)) AS REAL) / (SELECT weight FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 1.0 * highest_weight / lowest_weight AS times FROM ( SELECT weight AS highest_weight , MAX ( height ) FROM Player ) JOIN ( SELECT weight AS lowest_weight , MIN ( height ) FROM Player )

question: How many times does the tallest player weigh as much as the shortest player, if the the tallest player weighed 170 lbs instead?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SELECT weight FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) LIMIT 1) * 1.0 / (SELECT weight FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player) LIMIT 1) END AS ratio LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 170.0 / lowest_weight AS times FROM ( SELECT weight AS lowest_weight , MIN ( height ) FROM Player )

question: If the tallest player has a weight of 170lbs then calculate the ratio of the tallest players weight to the shortest players weight.
sql: SELECT 170.0 / MIN(weight) FROM Player WHERE NOT weight IS NULL LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 170.0 / lowest_weight AS times FROM ( SELECT weight AS lowest_weight , MIN ( height ) FROM Player )

question: List the name, height, weight and overall rating of players with the highest body mass index.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, p.height, p.weight, pa.overall_rating FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id ORDER BY (p.weight * 1.0 / ((p.height / 100.0) * (p.height / 100.0))) DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT B.player_name , B.height , B.weight , A.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id JOIN ( SELECT B.player_fifa_api_id , B.weight * 0.45 / ( ( B.height / 100 ) * ( B.height / 100 ) ) AS BMI FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id ) AS C ON A.player_fifa_api_id = C.player_fifa_api_id ORDER BY C.BMI DESC LIMIT 1

question: As sorted by highest body mass index, give me the name, height, weight and rating overall of players.
sql: SELECT p.player_name, p.height, p.weight, pa.overall_rating FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id ORDER BY (p.weight * 1.0 / (p.height / 100.0) / (p.height / 100.0)) DESC LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT B.player_name , B.height , B.weight , A.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id JOIN ( SELECT B.player_fifa_api_id , B.weight * 0.45 / ( ( B.height / 100 ) * ( B.height / 100 ) ) AS BMI FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id ) AS C ON A.player_fifa_api_id = C.player_fifa_api_id ORDER BY C.BMI DESC LIMIT 1

question: Among players who have both "low" attacking and defensive work rate, how many players are right-footed? How many players are left-footed? What is the difference between them?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Right' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS right_footed, SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS left_footed, SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Right' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM Player_Attributes WHERE attacking_work_rate = 'low' AND defensive_work_rate = 'low' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT left_count , right_count , ABS ( left_count - right_count ) FROM ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.player_name ) ) AS left_count FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.attacking_work_rate = "low" and A.defensive_work_rate = "low" and A.preferred_foot = "left" ) JOIN ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( B.player_name ) ) AS right_count FROM Player_Attributes A JOIN Player B ON A.player_fifa_api_id = B.player_fifa_api_id WHERE A.attacking_work_rate = "low" and A.defensive_work_rate = "low" and A.preferred_foot = "right" )

question: What is the count, and difference between, of the right-footed players and the left footed players only considering players with "low" attacking and defensive foot work rate?
sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Right' THEN 1 END) AS right_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Left' THEN 1 END) AS left_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Right' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'Left' THEN 1 END) AS difference FROM Player_Attributes WHERE attacking_work_rate = 'low' AND defensive_work_rate = 'low' LIMIT 1000

question: How many cases of wine were produced in total in 2009, and what percentage was the increase over 2007?
sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(Cases) FROM wine WHERE Year = 2009) AS total_2009, (SELECT (SUM(Cases) - (SELECT SUM(Cases) FROM wine WHERE Year = 2007)) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(Cases) FROM wine WHERE Year = 2007) FROM wine WHERE Year = 2009 LIMIT 1) AS percentage_increase LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT n_2009 , 100.0 * ( n_2009 - n_2007 ) / n_2007 AS growth_rate FROM ( SELECT SUM ( Cases ) AS n_2009 FROM wine WHERE Year = "2009" ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( Cases ) AS n_2007 FROM wine WHERE Year = "2007" )

question: What is the total case quantity of wine production in 2009 and how does this compare (in percentage change) relative to 2007 production?
sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(Cases) FROM wine WHERE Year = 2009) AS total_2009, (SELECT SUM(Cases) FROM wine WHERE Year = 2007) AS total_2007, CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(Cases) FROM wine WHERE Year = 2007) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(((SELECT SUM(Cases) FROM wine WHERE Year = 2009) - (SELECT SUM(Cases) FROM wine WHERE Year = 2007)) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(Cases) FROM wine WHERE Year = 2007), 2) END AS percentage_change LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT n_2009 , 100.0 * ( n_2009 - n_2007 ) / n_2007 AS growth_rate FROM ( SELECT SUM ( Cases ) AS n_2009 FROM wine WHERE Year = "2009" ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( Cases ) AS n_2007 FROM wine WHERE Year = "2007" )

gold: SELECT n_2009 , 100.0 * ( n_2009 - n_2007 ) / n_2007 AS growth_rate FROM ( SELECT SUM ( Cases ) AS n_2009 FROM wine WHERE Year = "2009" AND Name != "Sauvignon Blanc" ) JOIN ( SELECT SUM ( Cases ) AS n_2007 FROM wine WHERE Year = "2007" )

question: It takes 1.2 kilograms of grapes to make a bottle of red wine. How many tons of grapes were used to produce red wine in 2005?
sql: SELECT SUM(w.Cases * 1.2 / 1000) AS tons_of_grapes FROM wine AS w JOIN grapes AS g ON w.Grape = g.Grape WHERE w.Year = 2005 AND g.Color = 'Red' LIMIT 1000

question: If a winery has produced wine for three consecutive years without a rating below 90, it is rated as a "premium winery". What percentage of wineries are premium winery?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_premium = 1 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS premium_percentage FROM (SELECT Winery, MAX(CASE WHEN Score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_premium FROM wine GROUP BY Winery HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Year) >= 3 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Year FROM wine AS w2 WHERE w2.Winery = wine.Winery ORDER BY Year)) >= 3 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Year FROM wine AS w2 WHERE w2.Winery = wine.Winery AND w2.Score >= 90 ORDER BY Year)) = COUNT(DISTINCT Year)) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) FROM wine ) AS percent FROM ( SELECT A.Winery , A.No , A.Year , A.Score , B.No , B.Year , B.Score , C.No , C.Year , C.Score FROM wine A JOIN wine B ON A.Winery = B.Winery JOIN wine C ON A.Winery = C.Winery WHERE A.Score >= 90 AND B.Score >= 90 AND C.Score >= 90 AND B.Year - A.Year = 1 AND C.Year - B.Year = 1 )

question: Which wineries are considered premium as measured by producing no wine with a rating lower than 90 for three consecutive years?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT Winery FROM wine AS w1 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wine AS w2 WHERE w2.Winery = w1.Winery AND w2.Score < 90) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wine AS w3 WHERE w3.Winery = w1.Winery AND w3.Year = (SELECT MIN(w4.Year) FROM wine AS w4 WHERE w4.Winery = w1.Winery)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wine AS w5 WHERE w5.Winery = w1.Winery AND w5.Year = (SELECT MIN(w6.Year) + 1 FROM wine AS w6 WHERE w6.Winery = w1.Winery)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wine AS w7 WHERE w7.Winery = w1.Winery AND w7.Year = (SELECT MIN(w8.Year) + 2 FROM wine AS w8 WHERE w8.Winery = w1.Winery)) LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) FROM wine ) AS percent FROM ( SELECT A.Winery , A.No , A.Year , A.Score , B.No , B.Year , B.Score , C.No , C.Year , C.Score FROM wine A JOIN wine B ON A.Winery = B.Winery JOIN wine C ON A.Winery = C.Winery WHERE A.Score >= 90 AND B.Score >= 90 AND C.Score >= 90 AND B.Year - A.Year = 1 AND C.Year - B.Year = 1 )

question: If a winery has produced wine for three consecutive years without a rating below 90, it is rated as a "premium winery". If the score of wine made from Pinot Noir grapes was decreased by 5 points, what percentage of wineries are premium winery?

gold: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT ( DISTINCT ( Winery ) ) FROM wine ) AS percent FROM ( SELECT A.Winery , A.No , A.Year , A.Score , B.No , B.Year , B.Score , C.No , C.Year , C.Score FROM ( SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score - 5 AS Score FROM wine WHERE Grape = "Pinot Noir" UNION ALL SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score FROM wine WHERE Grape != "Pinot Noir" ) A JOIN ( SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score - 5 AS Score FROM wine WHERE Grape = "Pinot Noir" UNION ALL SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score FROM wine WHERE Grape != "Pinot Noir" ) B ON A.Winery = B.Winery JOIN ( SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score - 5 AS Score FROM wine WHERE Grape = "Pinot Noir" UNION ALL SELECt Winery , No , Year , Score FROM wine WHERE Grape != "Pinot Noir" ) C ON A.Winery = C.Winery WHERE A.Score >= 90 AND B.Score >= 90 AND C.Score >= 90 AND B.Year - A.Year = 1 AND C.Year - B.Year = 1 )
